Taaruf-e-Quran-e-Hakim

Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se jo huroof suraton ke shuru mein aate hain unki poori tafseel is tafsir ke shuru mein Surah Al-Baqarah ke un huroof ke bayan mein guzar chuki hai jise dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin. Yahan farman hai ke yeh Quran lafzon mein muhkam aur maani mein mufassal hai. Pas mazmoon aur maani har tarah se kamil hai. Yeh us Allah ka kalam hai jo apne aqwal-o-ahkam mein Hakim hai. Jo kamon ke anjam se khabardar hai. Yeh Quran Allah ki ibadat karane aur doosron ki ibadat se rokne ke liye utra hai. Sab rasoolon par pehli wahi Tauhid ki aati rahi hai. Sab se yahi farmaya gaya hai ke log Allah ki ibadat karein. Us ke siva aur kisi ki parastish na karein. Phir farmaya ke Allah ki mukhalifat ki wajah se jo azab aa jate hain un se main dara raha hoon aur us ki ita'at ki bina par jo sawab milte hain, un ki main basharat sunata hoon. 

Huzoor ﷺ Safa pahadi par chadh kar Quraysh ke khandanon ko aawaz dete hain. Zyada qareeb wale pehle, phir tarteeb-war jab sab jama ho jate hain toh aap un se daryaft farmate hain ke agar main tum se kahun ke koi lashkar subah ko tum par dhawa karne wala hai toh kya tum mujhe sacha samjhoge? Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum ne aaj tak aap ki zaban se koi jhoot suna hi nahin. Aap ne farmaya suno main tum se kehta hoon ke Qayamat ke din tumhari in bad-aamaliyon ki wajah se sakht-tr azab hoga. Pas tum un se hoshiyar ho jao. 

Phir irshad hai ke اے نبی ﷺ yeh bhi keh do ke main tumhein apne guzishta gunahon se tauba karne aur آئندہ ke liye Allah ki taraf rujoo karne ki hidayat karta hoon agar tum bhi aisa hi karte rahe toh duniya mein bhi achi zindagi basar karoge aur naik amal karne walon ko Allah Ta'ala akhirat mein bhi bade buland darje inayat farmayega. 

Quran-e-Karim ne (man 'amila salihan min dhakarin aw untha wa huwa mu'minun falanuhyiyannahu hayatan tayyibatan wa lanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-ahsani ma kanu ya'maloon) (16. An-Nahl: 97) mein farmaya hai ke jo mard-o-aurat iman dar ho kar naik amal bhi karta rahe, use hum pakeeza zindagi se zinda rakhenge. 

Sahih hadith mein bhi hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Sa'd R.A se farmaya ke Allah ki razamandi ki talash mein tu jo kuch bhi kharch karega us ka ajr Allah Ta'ala se payega, yahan tak ke jo luqma tu apni biwi ke munh mein de us ka bhi. 

Fazl walon ko Allah Ta'ala fazl dega. Yaani gunah toh barabar likha jata hai aur neki das gunah likhi jati hai phir agar gunah ki saza duniya mein hi ho gayi toh nekiyan jyon ki tyon baqi rahein. Aur agar yahan us ki saza na mili toh zyada se zyada ek neki us ke muqabil ja kar bhi nau nekiyan bach rahein. Phir jis ki ikaiyan dahaiyon par ghalib aa jain woh toh waqai khud hi bad aur bura hai. Phir unhein dhamkaya jata hai jo Allah ke ahkam ki rogardani kar lein aur rasoolon ki na manein ke aise logon ko zaroor zaroor Qayamat ke din sakht azab hoga.

Tum sab ko laut kar Malik hi ke paas jana hai, usi ke samne jama hona hai. Woh har cheez par qadir hai, apne doston se ehsan, apne dushmanon se intiqam, makhlooq ki nayi paidaish, sab us ke qabze mein hain. Pas pehle raghib kiya aur ab daraya.

Andheron ki chadaron mein maujud har cheez ko dekhta hai. Asmaan ki taraf apni sharmgah ka rukh karna woh makruh jaante thay. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki qirat mein "Tasnunee" hai. Mujama'at ke waqt aur tanhai mein woh uriyani se hijab karte thay ke paikhane ke waqt asmaan tale nange hon ya mujama'at is halat mein karein. Woh apne saron ko dhamp lete aur yeh bhi murad hai ke woh Allah ke bare mein shak karte thay aur kaam burai ke karte thay. Kehte hain ke bure kaam ya bure amal ke waqt woh jhuk jhuk kar apne seene dohre kar daalte goya ke woh Allah se sharma rahe hain aur us se chup rahe hain. 

Toh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke raton ko kapre orhe hue bhi jo tum karte ho us se bhi Allah toh khabardard hai. Jo chhupao jo kholo, jo dilon aur seenon mein rakho, woh sab ko jaanta hai, dil ke bhed, seene ke raaz aur har ek poshdegi us par zahir hai. 

Zuhair bin Abu Sulma apne mashhoor mu'allaqa mein kehta hai ke tumhare dilon ki koi baat Allah Ta'ala par chhupi hui nahi, tum go kisi khayal mein ho lekin yaad rakho ke Allah sab kuch jaanta hai. Mumkin hai ke tumhare bad khayalat par woh tumhe yahin saza kare aur ho sakta hai ke woh nama-e-aamal mein likh liye jayein aur Qayamat ke din pesh kiye jayein. Yeh jahiliyat ka shair hai. Isse Allah ka, uske kamil ilm ka, Qayamat ka aur us din ki jaza-saza ka, aamal-name ka aur Qayamat ke din uske pesh hone ka ikrar hai. 

Is aayat ka ek matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke yeh log jab Rasool Maqbool (ﷺ) ke paas se guzarte toh seena mor lete aur sar dhanp lete. 

(Ala innahum yasthuna sudurahum liyastakhfu minhu ala hina yastaghshuna thiyahum ya'lamu ma yusirruna wa ma yu'linuna innahu alimun bi-zatis sudur) (Surah Hud: 11) hai. 

Is se murad yeh hai ke Allah se chhupna chahte hain, yehi awla hai kyunke isi ke baad hai ke jab yeh log sote waqt kapre orh lete hain us waqt bhi Allah Ta'ala ko unke tamam afaal ka jo woh chhup kar karein aur jo zahir karein ilm hota hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki qirat mein (Aayat: Ala innahum tasthuni sudurahum) hai. Is qirat par bhi maani taqriban yak-saan hain.

Har makhlooq ka rozi rasan har ek chhoti bari, khushki tari ki makhlooq ka rozi rasan ek Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Wohi un ke chalne phirne aane jaane, rehne sehne, marne jeene aur maa ke raham mein qarar pakadne aur baap ki peeth ki jagah ko jaanta hai. Imam Ibn Abi Hatim ne is ayat ki tafseer mein mufassireen-e-kiram ke bohat se aqwal zikr kiye hain wallahu a'lam. Yeh تمام baatein Allah ke paas ki wazeh kitab mein likhi hui hain jiska farman hai (Wa ma min dabbatin fil-ardi wa la ta'irin yatiru bi-janahayhi illa umamun amthalukum ma farratna fil-kitabi min shayin thumma ila rabbihim yuhsharun) (6. Al-An'am: 38) ya'ani zameen par chalne wale janwar aur apne paron par udne wale parind sab ke sab tum jaisi hi ummatin hain, hum ne kitab mein koi cheez nahi chodi, phir sab ke sab apne parwardigar ki taraf jama kiye jayenge. Aur farman hai (Wa 'indahu mafatihul-ghaybi la ya'lmuha illa huwa wa ya'lamu ma fil-barri wal-bahri wa ma tasqutu min waraqatin illa ya'lamuha wa la habbatin fi zulumatil-ardi wa la ratbin wa la yabisin illa fi kitabin mubeen) (6. Al-An'am: 59) ya'ani ghaib ki kunjiyaan usi Allah ke paas hain. Unhein us ke siwa koi nahi jaanta. Khushki tari ki tamam cheezon ka use ilm hai jo patta jhadta hai us ke ilm mein hai koi dana zameen ke andheron mein aur koi tar-o-khushk cheez aisi nahi jo wazeh kitab mein na ho

Takhleeq-e-Kainat Ka Tazkira

Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ki use har cheez par qudrat hai. Asman-o-Zameen ko us ne sirf chhe din mein paida kiya hai. Is se pehle iska Arsh-e-Kareem pani ke upar tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Aey Bani Tamim! Tum khushkhabri qabul karo." Unhone kaha: "Khushkhabriyan to aap ne suna din ab kuch dilwaiye." Aap ne farmaya: "Aey Ahl-e-Yaman tum qabul karo." Unhone kaha: "Haan humein qabul hai. Makhlooq ki ibtida to humein sunaye ke kis tarah hui?" Aap ne farmaya: "Sab se pehle Allah tha. Uska Arsh pani ke upar tha. Us ne Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein har cheez ka tazkira likha." Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Imran R.A kehte hain: "Huzoor ﷺ ne utna hi farmaya tha jo kisi ne aa kar mujhe khabar di ke teri oontni zanu khulwa kar bhag gayi, main use dhoondne chala gaya. Phir mujhe nahi maloom ke kya baat hui?" Yeh Hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai: "Allah tha aur us se pehle kuch na tha." Ek riwayat mein hai: "Uske sath kuch na tha. Uska Arsh pani par tha. Us ne har cheez ka tazkira likha. Phir Asman-o-Zameen ko paida kiya." Muslim ki Hadith mein hai: "Zameen-o-Asman ki paidaish se pachas hazaar saal pehle Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooqat ki taqdeer likhi, uska Arsh pani par tha."

Sahih Bukhari mein is ayat ki tafseer ke mauqe par ek Qudsi Hadith laye hain ke: "Aey insan tu meri raah mein kharch kar main tujhe doonga." Aur farmaya: "Allah ka haath upar hai." Din raat ka kharch ismein koi kami nahi lata. Khayal to karo ke Asman-o-Zameen ki paidaish se ab tak kitna kuch kharch kiya hoga lekin iske dahane haath mein jo tha woh kam nahi hota, uska Arsh pani par tha. Uske haath mein Mizan hai, jhukata hai aur ooncha karta hai. 

Musnad mein hai Abu Razin Laqeet bin Amir bin Muntafiq Uqaili ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke makhlooq paida karne se pehle hamara Parwardigar kahan tha? Aap ne farmaya: "Ama mein, niche bhi hawa aur upar bhi hawa, phir Arsh ko iske baad paida kiya." Yeh riwayat Tirmizi Kitab-o-Tafseer mein bhi hai. Sunan Ibn Majah mein bhi hai. Imam Tirmizi ise Hasan kehte hain. 

Mujahid ka qaul hai ke kisi cheez ko paida karne se pehle Arsh-e-Ilahi pani par tha. Wahab, Zakhrah, Qatada, Ibn Jarir waghera bhi yehi kehte hain. Qatada kehte hain: "Allah Ta'ala batata hai ke Asman-o-Zameen ki paidaish se pehle ibtida-e-makhlooq kis tarah hui." Rabih bin Anas kehte hain ke uska Arsh pani par tha. Jab Asman-o-Zameen ko paida kiya to is pani ke do hisse kar diye, nisf Arsh ke niche, yehi Bahr-e-Masjood hai. Ibn Abbas farmate hain: "Bojh-e-bulandi ke Arsh ko Arsh kaha jata hai." Saad Tai farmate hain ke Arsh surakh yaqoot ka hai. 

Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain: "Allah usi tarah tha jis tarah us ne apne Nafs-e-Kareem ka wasf bayan kiya. Isliye ke kuch na tha, pani tha, is par Arsh tha, Arsh par Dhul-Jalal-wal-Ikram, Dhul-Izzat-wal-Sultan, Dhul-Mulk-wal-Qudrah, Dhul-Ilm-wal-Rahmat-wal-N'imah tha jo jo chahe kar guzarne wala hai." 

Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke bare mein sawal hua ke pani kis cheez par tha?

Aap ne farmaya hawa ki peeth par. Phir farmata hai. Asman-o-zamin ki paidaish tumhare nafa ke liye hai aur tum is liye ho ke usi ek Khaliq ki ibadat karo, us ke sath kisi ko sharik na karo. Yaad rakho tum bekar paida nahi kiye gaye. Asman-o-zamin aur un ke darmiyan cheezein batil paida nahi keen yeh guman to kafiron ka hai aur kafiron ke liye aag ka azab aur ayat mein hai. (Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum abasan wa annakum ilaina la turja'oon) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 115) Kya tum yeh samajh baithe ho ke hum ne tumhein abas paida kiya hai aur tum hamari taraf lautaye na jaoge? Allah jo sacha malik hai wahi haq hai us ke siva koi mabood nahi woh Arsh-e-Karim ka Rab hai aur ayat mein hai insanon aur janoon ko main ne sirf apni ibadat ke liye hi paida kiya hai woh tumhein azma rahe hain ke tum mein se acche amal wale kaun hain? Yeh nahi farmaya ke zyada amal wale kaun hain? Is liye ke amal-e-hasan woh hota hai jis mein khulus ho aur Shariat-e-Muhammadiyah ki tabadari ho. In dono baton mein se agar ek bhi na ho to woh amal bekar aur gharat hai. Phir farmata hai ke Aey Nabi ﷺ agar aap unhein kahein ke tum marne ke baad zinda kiye jaoge jis Allah ne tumhein pehli bar paida kiya hai woh dobara bhi paida karega to saf keh denge ke hum ise nahi mante halanki qayil bhi hain ke zamin asman ka paida karne wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Zahir hai ke shuru jis par garan na guzra, is par dobara ki paidaish kaise garan guzregi? Yeh to ba-nisbat awal martibah ke bohat hi asman hai. Farman-e-Ilahi hai (Wa huwal-lazi yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo wa huwa ahwanu 'alaihi wa lahul-masalul-a'la fis-samawati wal-ardi wa huwal-'azizul-hakeem) (Surah Ar-Rum: 27) Usi ne pehli paidaish shuru mein ki wahi dobara paidaish karega aur yeh to us par nihayat hi asan hai aur ayat mein hai ke tum sab ka banana aur mar kar zinda karna mujh par aisa hi hai jaisa ek ka. Lekin yeh log ise nahi mante thay aur ise khule jadu se tabeer karte thay. Kufr-o-'anad se is qaul ko jadu ka asar khayal karte. Phir farmata hai ke agar hum azab-o-pakad ko un se kuch muqarrar muddat tak ke liye moakhar kar dein to yeh is ko na aane wala jaan kar jaldi ka mutalbah karne lagte hain ke azab hum se moakhar kyun ho gaye? Un ke dil mein kufr-o-shirk is tarah baith gaya hai ke us se chhutkara hi nahi milta. Ummat ka lafz Quran-o-Hadist mein kai ek mani mein musta'mil hai. Is se murad muddat bhi hai is ayat aur (Wa qalallazi naja minhumah wa ad-dakara ba'da ummatin ana unabbi-ukum bi-ta'wilihi fa arsiloon) (Surah Yusuf: 45) jo Surah Yusuf mein hai yehi mani hain. Imam-o-muqtadi ke mani mein bhi yeh lafz aaya hai. Jaise Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke bare mein (Inna Ibrahima kana ummatan qanitan lillahi haneefanw wa lam yaku minal-mushrikeen) (Surah An-Nahl: 120)

An-Nahl: 120) aaya hai. Millat aur deen ke baare mein bhi yehi lafz aata hai jaise mushrikon ka qoul (Bal qalu inna wajadna abaana ‘ala ummatin wa inna ‘ala asarihim muhtadoon) (Az-Zukhruf: 22) hai. Jama'at ke ma'ane mein bhi aata hai (Wajada ‘alaihi ummatan minan-nasi yasqoona wa wajada min doonihim imra'ataini) (Al-Qasas: 23) wali aayat mein aur aayat (Wa laqad ba'asna fi kulli ummatin rasoolan ani'budulla-ha wajtanibud-taghut) (An-Nahl: 36) mein. In aayaton mein ummat se murad kafir mo'min sab ummati hain. Jaise Muslim ki hadees hai, is ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat ka jo yahudi nasrani mera naam sune aur mujh par imaan na laaye woh jahannami hai. Haan tabe'dar ummat woh hai jo rasoolon ko maane, jaise (Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat lin-nasi ta'muroona bil-ma'roofi wa tanhoona ‘anil-munkari wa tu'minoona billahi wa lau amana ahlul-kitabi lakana khairal-lahum minhumul-mu'minoona wa aksaruhumul-fasiqoon) (Aal-e-Imran: 110) wali aayat mein. Saheeh hadees mein hai, main kahunga ummati ummati. Isi tarah ummat ka lafz firqe aur groh ke liye bhi musta'mil hota hai, jaise (Wa min qoumi moosa ummatun yahdoona bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'diloon) (Al-A'raf: 159) aur jaise (Min ahlil-kitabi ummatun qa'imatun yatloona aayatal-lahi aana'al-laili wa hum yasjudoon) (Aal-e-Imran: 113) mein.

Takhleeq-e-Kainat Ka Tazkira

Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ki use har cheez par qudrat hai. Asman-o-Zameen ko us ne sirf chhe din mein paida kiya hai. Is se pehle iska Arsh-e-Kareem pani ke upar tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Aey Bani Tamim! Tum khushkhabri qabul karo." Unhone kaha: "Khushkhabriyan to aap ne suna din ab kuch dilwaiye." Aap ne farmaya: "Aey Ahl-e-Yaman tum qabul karo." Unhone kaha: "Haan humein qabul hai. Makhlooq ki ibtida to humein sunaye ke kis tarah hui?" Aap ne farmaya: "Sab se pehle Allah tha. Uska Arsh pani ke upar tha. Us ne Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein har cheez ka tazkira likha." Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Imran R.A kehte hain: "Huzoor ﷺ ne utna hi farmaya tha jo kisi ne aa kar mujhe khabar di ke teri oontni zanu khulwa kar bhag gayi, main use dhoondne chala gaya. Phir mujhe nahi maloom ke kya baat hui?" Yeh Hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai: "Allah tha aur us se pehle kuch na tha." Ek riwayat mein hai: "Uske sath kuch na tha. Uska Arsh pani par tha. Us ne har cheez ka tazkira likha. Phir Asman-o-Zameen ko paida kiya." Muslim ki Hadith mein hai: "Zameen-o-Asman ki paidaish se pachas hazaar saal pehle Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooqat ki taqdeer likhi, uska Arsh pani par tha."

Sahih Bukhari mein is ayat ki tafseer ke mauqe par ek Qudsi Hadith laye hain ke: "Aey insan tu meri raah mein kharch kar main tujhe doonga." Aur farmaya: "Allah ka haath upar hai." Din raat ka kharch ismein koi kami nahi lata. Khayal to karo ke Asman-o-Zameen ki paidaish se ab tak kitna kuch kharch kiya hoga lekin iske dahane haath mein jo tha woh kam nahi hota, uska Arsh pani par tha. Uske haath mein Mizan hai, jhukata hai aur ooncha karta hai. 

Musnad mein hai Abu Razin Laqeet bin Amir bin Muntafiq Uqaili ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke makhlooq paida karne se pehle hamara Parwardigar kahan tha? Aap ne farmaya: "Ama mein, niche bhi hawa aur upar bhi hawa, phir Arsh ko iske baad paida kiya." Yeh riwayat Tirmizi Kitab-o-Tafseer mein bhi hai. Sunan Ibn Majah mein bhi hai. Imam Tirmizi ise Hasan kehte hain. 

Mujahid ka qaul hai ke kisi cheez ko paida karne se pehle Arsh-e-Ilahi pani par tha. Wahab, Zakhrah, Qatada, Ibn Jarir waghera bhi yehi kehte hain. Qatada kehte hain: "Allah Ta'ala batata hai ke Asman-o-Zameen ki paidaish se pehle ibtida-e-makhlooq kis tarah hui." Rabih bin Anas kehte hain ke uska Arsh pani par tha. Jab Asman-o-Zameen ko paida kiya to is pani ke do hisse kar diye, nisf Arsh ke niche, yehi Bahr-e-Masjood hai. Ibn Abbas farmate hain: "Bojh-e-bulandi ke Arsh ko Arsh kaha jata hai." Saad Tai farmate hain ke Arsh surakh yaqoot ka hai. 

Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain: "Allah usi tarah tha jis tarah us ne apne Nafs-e-Kareem ka wasf bayan kiya. Isliye ke kuch na tha, pani tha, is par Arsh tha, Arsh par Dhul-Jalal-wal-Ikram, Dhul-Izzat-wal-Sultan, Dhul-Mulk-wal-Qudrah, Dhul-Ilm-wal-Rahmat-wal-N'imah tha jo jo chahe kar guzarne wala hai." 

Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke bare mein sawal hua ke pani kis cheez par tha?

Aap ne farmaya hawa ki peeth par. Phir farmata hai. Asman-o-zamin ki paidaish tumhare nafa ke liye hai aur tum is liye ho ke usi ek Khaliq ki ibadat karo, us ke sath kisi ko sharik na karo. (Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum abasan wa annakum ilaina la turja'oon) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 115) Kya tum yeh samajh baithe ho ke hum ne tumhein abas paida kiya hai aur tum hamari taraf lautaye na jaoge? Insan ka nafsiati tajziya - Siwaye kamil iman walon ke umumnya logon mein jo buraiyan hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ke rahat ke baad ki sakhti par mayus aur mahz na-umeed hojate hain Allah se bad-gumani kar ke ayindah ke liye bhulai ko bhool baithte hain goya ke na kabhi us se pehle koi aaram uthaya tha na us ke baad kisi rahat ki tawaqqa hai. Yehi haal us ke barkhilaf bhi hai agar sakhti ke baad asani hogayi toh kehne lagte hain ke bas ab bura waqt tal gaya. Apni rahat apni tan-asaniyon par mast o be-fikr hojate hain. Dusron ka istihza karne lagte hain. Akar-foon mein parjate hain aur ayindah ki sakhti ko bilkul faramosh kardehte hain. Haan imandar is buri khaslat se mehfooz rehte hain, woh dukh dard mein sabr o istiqamat se kaam lete hain rahat o aaram mein Allah ki farman-bardari karte hain. Ye sabr par maghfirat aur neki par sawab pate hain. Chunacha Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai: Us ki qasam jis ke haath meri jaan hai ke Momin ko koi sakhti koi museebat koi dukh, koi gham aisa nahi pahunchta jis ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala us ki khataen maaf na farmata ho, yahan tak ke kanta lagne par bhi. Bukhari o Muslim ki ek aur Hadith mein hai Momin ke liye Allah Ta'ala ka har faisla sarasar behtar hai. Yeh rahat pakar shkr karta hai aur bhulai sametta hai. Takleef uthakar sabr karta hai, neki pata hai aur aisa haal Momin ke siwa aur kisi ka nahi ho. Isi ka bayan Surah Wal-Asr mein hai: Yani asr ke waqt ki qasam tamam insan nuqsan mein hain siwaye un ke jo iman layen aur sath hi nekiyan bhi karein aur ek dusre ko deen-e-haq ki aur sabr ki hidayat karte rahein. Yehi bayan (Innal-insana khuliqa haloo'an 19) (70. Al-Ma'arij: 19) mein hai.

Kafron ki tanqید ki parwah na karein. Kafron ki zuban par jo aata hai, wohi ta'na bazi Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par karte hain, isliye Allah Ta'ala apne sachhe paighambar ko dilasa aur tasalli deta hai ke aap na is kaam mein susti karein, na tang dil hon, yeh to un ka shiva hai. Kabhi woh kehte hain ke agar yeh Rasul hai toh khane peene ka mohtaj kyun hai? Bazaron mein kyun aata jata hai? Is ki ham-nowai mein koi farishta kyun nahi utra? Ise koi khazana kyun nahi diya gaya? Us ke khane ko koi khas bagh kyun nahi banaya gaya? Musalmano ko ta'na dete hain ke tum to is ke peeche chal rahe ho jis par jadoo kar diya gaya hai. 

Pas Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae paighambar! Aap malool-e-khatir na hon, azurda dil na hon, apne kaam se na rukiye, unhe haq ki pukar sunane mein kotahi na kijiye, din raat Allah ki taraf bulate rahiye. Humein maloom hai ke un ki takleef-deh baatein aap ko buri lagti hain, aap tavajjo bhi na kijiye. Aisa na ho aap mayus hojayen ya tang dil ho kar baith jayen ke yeh aawazein kaste hain, phabtiyan udate hain. Apne se pehle ke rasolon ko dekhiye sab jhutlaye gaye, sataye gaye aur sabir-o-sabit qadam rahe, yahan tak Allah ki madad aa pohnchi. 

Phir Quran ka mojiza bayan farmaya ke is jaisa Quran lana toh kahan? Is jaisi das suratein, balki ek surat bhi sari duniya mil kar bana kar nahi la sakti, isliye ke yeh Allah ka kalam hai. Jaisi is ki zaat misal se pak, waise hi is ki sifat-e-pak bhi be-misaal hain. Us ke kaam jaisa makhlooq ka kalam ho, yeh namumkin hai. Allah ki zaat is se buland-bala, pak aur munfarid hai, mabood aur Rabb sirf wohi hai. 

Jab tum se yehi nahi ho sakta aur ab tak nahi ho saka toh yaqeen karlo ke tum is ke banane se aajiz ho aur darasal yeh Allah ka kalam hai aur usi ki taraf se nazil hua hai. Us ka ilm, us ke ahkaam aur us ki rok-tok isi kalam mein hain aur sath hi maan lo ke mabood-e-barhaq sirf wohi hai, bas aao Islam ke jhande tale khade hojao.

Kabhi woh kehte hain ke agar yeh Rasul hai toh khane peene ka mohtaj kyun hai? Bazaron mein kyun aata jata hai? Is ki ham-nowai mein koi farishta kyun nahi utra? Ise koi khazana kyun nahi diya gaya? Us ke khane ko koi khas bagh kyun nahi banaya gaya? Musalmano ko ta'na dete hain ke tum to is ke peeche chal rahe ho jis par jadoo kar diya gaya hai. 

Pas Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae paighambar! Aap malool-e-khatir na hon, azurda dil na hon, apne kaam se na rukiye, unhe haq ki pukar sunane mein kotahi na kijiye, din raat Allah ki taraf bulate rahiye. Humein maloom hai ke un ki takleef-deh baatein aap ko buri lagti hain, aap tavajjo bhi na kijiye. Aisa na ho aap mayus hojayen ya tang dil ho kar baith jayen ke yeh aawazein kaste hain, phabtiyan udate hain. Apne se pehle ke rasolon ko dekhiye sab jhutlaye gaye, sataye gaye aur sabir-o-sabit qadam rahe, yahan tak Allah ki madad aa pohnchi. 

Phir Quran ka mojiza bayan farmaya ke is jaisa Quran lana toh kahan? Is jaisi das suratein, balki ek surat bhi sari duniya mil kar bana kar nahi la sakti, isliye ke yeh Allah ka kalam hai. Jaisi is ki zaat misal se pak, waise hi is ki sifat-e-pak bhi be-misaal hain. Us ke kaam jaisa makhlooq ka kalam ho, yeh namumkin hai. Allah ki zaat is se buland-bala, pak aur munfarid hai, mabood aur Rabb sirf wohi hai. 

Jab tum se yehi nahi ho sakta aur ab tak nahi ho saka toh yaqeen karlo ke tum is ke banane se aajiz ho aur darasal yeh Allah ka kalam hai aur usi ki taraf se nazil hua hai. Us ka ilm, us ke ahkaam aur us ki rok-tok isi kalam mein hain aur sath hi maan lo ke mabood-e-barhaq sirf wohi hai, bas aao Islam ke jhande tale khade hojao.

Riya har neki ke liye zehar hai. Ibn Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain riyakaron ki nekiyon ka badla sab kuch usi duniya mein mil jata hai. Zara si bhi kami nahi hoti. Pas jo shakhs duniya mein dikhave ke liye namaz padhe, roze rakhe ya tahajjud guzari kare, uska ajr use duniya mein hi mil jata hai. Akhirat mein woh khali hath aur mahz be-amal uthta hai. Hazrat Anas R.H o ghaira ka bayan hai yeh ayat yahood o nasara ke haq mein utri aur Mujahid R.H kahte hain riyakaron ke bare mein utri hai. Al-gharz kiska jo qasd ho usi ke mutabiq usse mamla hota hai, duniya talabi ke liye jo aamal hon woh akhirat mein kar-amad nahi ho sakte. Momin ki niyat aur maqsad chunke akhirat talabi hi hota hai Allah use akhirat mein uske aamal ka behtareen badla ata farmata hai aur duniya mein bhi uski nekiyan kaam ati hain. Aik marfoo hadith mein bhi yahi mazmoon aya hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki (Man kana yuridu al-ajilata ajjalna lahu fiha ma nashau liman nuridu thumma ja'alna lahu jahannama yaslaha mazmuman madhura - 17. Al-Isra: 18) mein bhi isi ka tafsili bayan hai ke duniya talab logon mein se jise hum jis qadar chahein de dete hain. Phir uska thikana jahnam hota hai jahan woh zalil o khwar ho kar dakhil hota hai. Haan jis ki talab akhirat ho aur bilkul usi ke mutabiq uska amal bhi ho aur woh iman dar bhi to aise logon ki koshish ki qadr-dani ki jati hai. Unhe har aik ko hum tere Rabb ki ata se badhate rahte hain, tere parwardigar ka inam kisi se roka hua nahi. Tu khud dekh le ke kis tarah hum ne aik ko aik par fazilat bakshi hai. Akhirat kya ba-aitibar darjon ke aur kya ba-aitibar fazilat ke bahut hi badi aur zabardast cheez hai. Aur ayat mein irshad hai (Man kana yuridu harsa al-akhirati nazid lahu fi harsihi wa man kana yuridu harsa ad-dunya nu'tihi minha wa ma lahu fi al-akhirati min nasibin - 42. Ash-Shura: 20) Jiska irada akhirat ki kheti ka ho hum khud usmein uske liye barkat ata farmate hain aur jiska irada duniya ki kheti ka ho hum go use usmein se kuch de dein lekin akhirat mein woh be-naseeb rah jata hai.

Momin kaun hain? In mominon ka wasaf bayan ho raha hai jo fitrat par qayam hain jo Allah ki wahdaniyat ko dil se mantey hain. Jaise Hukm-e-Ilahi hai ke (Fa aqim wajhaka lid-dini hanifan, fitrat-allahi allati fataran-nasa 'alaiha, la tabdila likhalq-illah, zalikad-dinul-qayyim, wa lakinna aktharan-nasi la ya'lamun) (Surah Ar-Rum: 30) Apna munh deen-e-hanif par qayam kar de Allah ki fitrat jis par us ne insani fitrat paida ki hai. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain har bacha fitrat par paida hota hai phir us ke maan baap use yahudi ya nasrani ya majusi bana lete hain jaise ke janwaro ke bachche sahi salim paida hote hain phir log un ke kaan kaat dalte hain. Muslim Sharif ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai main ne apne tamam bando ko muwahhid paida kiya hai lekin phir shaitan aakar unhe un ke deen se behka deta hai aur meri halal kardah cheezein un par haram kar deta hai aur unhe kehta hai ke mere sath unhe sharik karein jin ki koi dalil main ne nahi utari. Musnad aur Sunan mein hai ke har bacha isi millat par paida hota hai yahan tak ke us ki zuban khule, Al-Kh. Pas momin fitrat-e-Rabb par hi baqi raha hai. Pas ek to fitrat us ki sahi salim hoti hai phir us ke paas Allah ka shahid aata hai yani Allah ki shariat paighambar ke zariye pahunchti hai jo shariat Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ki shariat ke sath khatam huwi. Pas shahid se murad Hazrat Jibril A.S hain. Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ farmate hain ke Allah ki risalat awwalan Hazrat Jibril A.S laye aur aap ke wasite se Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ. Ek qaul mein kaha gaya hai ke woh Ali R.A hain lekin woh qaul zaeef hai. Us ka koi qayil sabit hi nahi. Haq baat pehli hi hai. Pas momin ki fitrat Allah ki wahi se mil jati hai. Ijmali taur par use pehle se hi yaqeen hota hai, phir shariat ki tafseelat ko maan leta hai. Us ki fitrat ek ek masle ki tasdeeq karti jati hai. Pas fitrat-e-saleem, us ke sath Quran ki taleem, jise Hazrat Jibril ne Allah ke Nabi ko pahunchaya aur aap ne apni ummat ko phir us se pehle ki ek aur taaid bhi maujood hai, woh Kitab-e-Musa yani Taurat jaise Allah ne us zamane ki ummat ke liye peshwai ke qabil bana kar bheji thi aur jo Allah ki taraf se rahmat thi us par jin ka pura iman hai woh lamahala us Nabi aur us Kitab par bhi iman late hain kyunki us Kitab ne is Kitab par iman lane ki rahnumai ki hai. Pas ye log is Kitab par bhi iman late hain. Phir pure Quran ko ya us ke kisi hisse ko na manne walon ka saza ka bayan farmaya ke duniya walon mein se jo giroh jo firqa use na mane khwah yahudi ho, khwah nasrani kahin ka ho, koi ho, kisi rangat aur shakal-o-surat ka ho, Quran pahuncha aur na mana woh jahannami hai. Jaise Rabb-ul-Alameen ne apne Nabi ki zubani isi Quran-e-Kareem mein farmaya hai: (Li undirakum bihi wa man balagha) (Surah Al-An'am: 19).

Al-An'am: 19) Ke main us se tumhein bhi aagah kar raha hoon aur unhein bhi jinhein yeh pahunch jaye aur aayat mein hai (Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni Rasulullahi ilaikum jami'a) 7. Al-A'raf: 158) logon mein elaan kardo ke ae insano! Main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka Rasul hoon. Sahih Muslim mein hai Rasul Allah ﷺ farmate hain us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke is ummat mein se jo bhi mujhe sun le aur phir mujh par iman na laye woh jahannami hai. Hadrat Sa'eed bin Jubair farmate hain main jo sahih hadith sunta hoon us ki tasdeeq Kitabullah mein zaroor pata hoon. Mandarja bala hadith sun kar main is talash mein laga ke is ki tasdeeq Quran ki kisi aayat se hoti hai toh mujhe yeh ayat mili pas tamam deen wale is se murad hain. Phir Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ke is Quran ke Allah ki taraf se sarasar haq hone mein tujhe koi shak-o-shubha na karna chahiye jaise irshad hai ke is kitab ke Rabb-ul-Alamin ki taraf se nazil shuda hone mein koi shak-o-shubha nahi. Aur jagah hai (Ayat zalikal-kitabu la raiba fih) is kitab mein koi shak nahi. Phir irshad hai ke aksar log iman se kore hote hain jaise farman hai (Wa ma aksar-un-nasi wa lau harasta bi-mu'minin 12. Yusuf: 103) yaani go teri chahat ho lekin yaqeen karle ke aksar log momin nahi honge. Aur aayat mein hai (Wa in tuti' aksara man fil-ardi yudillooka 'an sabilillahi in yattabi'una illaz-zanna wa in hum illa yakhrusun 6. Al-An'am: 116) agar tu duniya walon ki aksariyat ki pairwi karega toh woh toh tujhe rah-e-haq se bhatka denge aur aayat mein hai (Wa laqad sadaqa 'alaihim iblisu zannahu fattaba'uhu illa fariqan minal-mu'minin) 34. Saba': 20) yaani un par Iblis ne apna guman sach kar dikhaya aur siwaye mominoon ki ek mukhtasar si jama'at ke baaqi sab usi ke peeche lag gaye.

Allah Jalla Shanuhu par buhtan bandhne wale
Jo log Allah ke zimme buhtan bandh lein, un ka anjam aur Roz-e-Qayamat ke din ki sari makhlooq ke samne ki un ki ruswai ka bayan ho raha hai. Musnad Ahmad mein Safwan bin Muhriz kahte hain ke main Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar ka hath thame hue tha ke ek shakhs aap ke pas aya phir puchne laga ke aap ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se Qayamat ke din ki sargoshi ke bare mein kya suna hai? Aap ne farmaya maine Huzoor ﷺ se suna hai ke Allah Azzawajal momin ko apne se qareeb karega yahan tak ke apna bazu us par rakh dega aur use logon ki nigahon se chhipa lega aur use us ke gunahon ka ikrar karayega ke kya tujhe apna falan gunah yaad hai? Aur falan bhi aur falan bhi? Yeh ikrar karta jayega yahan tak ke samajh lega ke bas ab halak hua. Us waqt Ar-Rahman-ur-Raheem farmayega ke mere bande duniya mein in par parda dalta raha sun aj bhi main inhen bakhshta hoon. Phir us ki nekiyon ka amalnama use de diya jayega. Aur kuffar aur munafiqeen par gawah pesh honge jo kahenge ke yahi woh hain jo Allah par jhoot boltethe yaad rahe ke in zalimon par Allah ki lanat hai. Yeh hadith Bukhari o Muslim mein bhi hai. 

Yeh log itba-e-haq, hidayat aur Jannat se auron ko rokte rahe aur apna tarika tedha tircha hi talash karte rahe sath hi Qayamat aur Akhirat ke din ke bhi munkir hi rahe aur use mana hi nahi. Yaad rahe ke yeh Allah ke matahat hain woh un se har waqt intiqam lene par qadir hai, agar chahe to Akhirat se pehle duniya mein hi pakad le lekin us ki taraf se thodi si dheel inhen mil gayi hai. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Allah Ta'ala zalimon ko mohlat de deta hai bilakhir jab pakadta hai tab chhodta hi nahi. 

In ki sazayein badhti hi chali jayengi. Is liye ke Allah ki di hui quwaton se unhon ne kam na liya. Sunne se kanon ko behra rakha. Haq ki tabedari se ankhon ko andha rakha Jahannam mein jate waqt khud hi kahenge ke (Ayat: Law kunna nasmau aw naqilu ma kunna fi ashabis saeer) yani agar sunte hote aql rakhte hote toh aj dozakhi na bante. Yahi farman (Ayat: Allazeena kafaru wa saddu ‘an sabilillahi zidnahum azaban fawqal azab, kh) mein hai ke kafiron ke liye, Allah ki rah se rokne walon ke liye azab par azab badhta chala jayega. Har ek hukum adooli par, har ek burai ke kam par saza bhugatenge. Pas sahih qaul yahi hai ke Akhirat ki nisbat ke aitbaar se kuffar bhi furoo'-e-shara' ke mukallaf hain. 

Yahi hain jinhon ne apne ap ko nuqsan pahunchaya aur khud apne taiin jahannami banaya. Jahan ka azab zara si der bhi halka nahi hoga. Ag ke sholay kam hone toh kahan aur tez tez hote jayenge jinhon ne ghad liya tha yani but aur Allah ke shareek waghera aj woh un ke kisi kam na ayenge balke nazar bhi na padenge balke aur nuqsan pahunchayenge. Woh to un ke dushman ho jayenge aur un ke shirq se saf mukar jayenge. Go yeh unhen bais-e-izzat samajhte hain lekin darhaqeeqat woh un ke liye bais-e-zillat hain.

Khule taur par is baat ka Roz-e-Qayamat inkar kar dein ge ke in mushrikon ne inhein pooja. Yeh irshad Khalil-ur-Rahman A.S ka apni qaum se tha ke in buton se go tum duniyawi talluqat wabasta rakho lekin Roz-e-Qayamat aik doosre ka inkar kar dein ge aur aik doosre par laanat karne lagenge. Aur tum sab ka thikana Jahannam hoga aur koi kisi ko koi madad na pohchaaye ga. Yahi mazmoon (Iz tabarra-al-lazina-ttabi'u minal-lazina-ttaba'u wa ra'awul-azaaba wa taqatta'at bihimul-asbab) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 166) mein hai yaani us waqt peshwa log apne mureedon se dast-bardar ho jayein ge, Azab-e-Ilahi aankhon dekh lein ge aur bahmi talluqat sab munqata ho jayein ge. Isi qism ki aur bhi bohat si aayatein hain woh bhi in ki halakat aur nuqsan ki khabar deti hain. Yaqinan yahi log Roz-e-Qayamat sab se zyada nuqsan uthayein ge. Jannat ke darjon ke badle unhon ne Jahannam ke garhe liye. Allah ki naimaton ke badle Jahannam ki aag qabool ki. Meethe thande khushgawar Jannati pani ke badle Jahannam ka aag jaisa kholta hua garam pani, inhein Hoor-e-Ien ke badle laho peep aur buland-o-bala mahalat ke badle Dozakh ke tang muqamat unhon ne liye, Rabb-e-Rahman ki nazdiki aur deedar ke badle is ka gazab aur saza inhein mili. Beshak yahan yeh sakht ghate mein rahe.

Aqal-o-hosh aur iman wale log:

Buron ke zikr ke baad ach permukaan (achhe) logon ka bayaan ho raha hai jin ke dil iman wale, jin ke jismani aza farmaan-bardari karne wale the, qaul-o-feal se farmaan-e-Rabb baja lane wale aur Rabb ki nafarmani se bachne wale the, yeh log jannat ke waris honge. Buland-o-bala bala khane, bichhe bichhaye takht, chakhye hue khushon aur mewon ke darakht, ubhre ubhre farsh, khoobsurat biwiyan, qism qism ke khush zaiqa phal, chahat ke lazeez khane peene aur sab se barh kar deedar-e-Ilahi yeh nematein hongi jo un ke liye hamishgi ke liye hongi. Na unhein maut aayegi na burhapa, na beemari, na ghaflat, na rafa-e-hajat hogi, na thook, na naak mein sika (ya mushk), na bu wala paseena aayega aur ghiza hazam.

Pehle biyan kardah kafir shaqi log aur yeh momin muttaqi log bilkul wahi nisbat rakhte hain jo andhe behre aur beena aur sunte mein hain. Kafir duniya mein haq ko dekhne mein andhe the aur akhirat ke din bhi bhalai ki raah nahi payenge na use dekhenge. Woh haqaniyat ki daleelon ke sunne se behre the, nafa dene wali baat sunte hi na the, agar un mein koi bhalai hoti to Allah Ta'ala unhein zaroor sunata. 

Is ke bar-khilaf momin samajh-dar, zaki, aaqil, alim, dekhta, bhalta, sochta, samajhta haq-o-batil mein tameez karta. Bhalai le leta, burai chhor deta, daleel aur shubah mein farq kar leta aur batil se bachta, haq ko manta. Batلایe yeh dono kaise barabar ho sakte hain? Tajub hai ke phir bhi tum aise do mukhtalif shakhson mein farq nahi samajhte. 

Irshad hai: 
(لَا يَسْتَوِيْٓ اَصْحٰبُ النَّارِ وَاَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ ۭ اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَاۗىِٕزُوْنَ)
Dozakhi aur jannati ek nahi hote, jannati to bilkul kamyab hain. (Surah Al-Hashr: 20)

Aur aayat mein hai: Andha aur dekhne wala barabar nahi, andhera aur ujala barabar nahi, saya aur dhoop barabar nahi, zinda aur murda barabar nahi. Allah to jise chahe suna sakta hai to qabr walon ko suna nahi sakta. Tu to sirf aagah kar dene wala hai. Hum ne tujhe haq ke sath khushkhabri dene wala aur darane wala bana kar bheja hai, har har ummat mein darane wala ho chuka hai.

Agar tum ne khilaf-e-warzi ki toh Qayamat ke din ke dardnak sakht azaabon mein mujhe tumhare lene ka khauf hai. Is par qaum ke kafiron ke ru'asa aur umra bol uthe ke aap koi farishta toh hain nahi hum jaise hi insaan hain. Phir kaise mumkin hai ke hum sab ko chhor kar tum ek hi ke paas wahi aaye. Aur hum apni ankhon dekh rahe hain ke aise razeel log aap ke halqe mein shamil ho gaye hain koi shareef aur ra'ees aap ka farman-bardar nahi hua aur yeh log be-soche samjhe baghair ghor-o-fikr ke aap ki majlis mein aan baithe hain aur haan mein haan milaye jate hain. Phir hum dekhte hain ke is naye deen ne tumhein koi faida bhi nahi pahunchaya ke tum khush-haal ho gaye ho tumhari roziyan barh gayi hon ya khalq-o-khulq mein tumhein koi bartari hum par hasil ho gayi ho. Balkah hamare khayal se tum sab ke sab jhoote hain. Neki aur salahiyat aur ibadat par jo wade tum hamein akhirat mulk ke de rahe hain hamare nazdeek toh yeh sab bhi jhooti baatein hain. Balkah haq baat yeh hai ke haq ki pairwi karne wale hi shareef log hain. Chahe woh maskeen muflis hi hon aur haq se ro-gardani karne wale hain zaleel aur razeel hain go woh ghani maldar aur ameer umra hon. Haan yeh waqie hai ke sachai ki aawaz ko pehle pehal ghareeb maskeen log hi qubool karte hain aur ameer kabeer log naak bhon charhane lagte hain. Farman-e-Quran hai ke tujh se pehle jis jis basti mein hamare anbiya aaye wahan ke bare logon ne yahi kaha ke hum ne apne baap-dadon ko jis deen par paya hai hum toh unhi ki khosha-cheeni karte rahenge. Shah-e-Room Herqal ne jo Abu Sufyan se poocha tha ke shareef logon ne is ki tabadari ki hai ya zaeef logon ne? Toh us ne yahi jawab diya tha ke zaeefon ne jis par Herqal ne kaha tha ke rasoolon ke tabad-dar yahi log hote hain. Haq ki fori qubooliyat bhi koi aib ki baat nahi, haq ki wazahat ke baad raye fikar ki zaroorat hi kya hai? Balkah har aqalmand ka kaam yahi hai ke haq ko manne mein sabaqat aur jaldi kare. Is mein tamul karna jahalat aur kund-zehni hai. Allah ke tamam paighambar bahut wazeh aur saaf aur khuli hui dalelein le kar aate hain.

Un ka teesra itraaz "hum koi bartari tum mein nahi dekhte" yeh bhi un ke andhe pan ki wajah se hai. Apni un ki aankhein aur kaan na hon aur ek maujood cheez ka inkaar karein toh fi-al-waqie us ka na hona sabit nahi ho sakta. Yeh toh na haq ko dekhein na haq ko sunein balki apne shakk mein ghote lagate rehte hain. Apni jahalat mein dabkiyan marte rehte hain. Jhoote muftari khaali haath, razeel aur nuqsanon wale hain.

Aur hum apni ankhon dekh rahe hain ke aise razeel log aap ke halqe mein shamil ho gaye hain koi shareef aur ra'ees aap ka farman-bardar nahi hua aur yeh log be-soche samjhe baghair ghor-o-fikr ke aap ki majlis mein aan baithe hain aur haan mein haan milaye jate hain. Phir hum dekhte hain ke is naye deen ne tumhein koi faida bhi nahi pahunchaya ke tum khush-haal ho gaye ho tumhari roziyan barh gayi hon ya khalq-o-khulq mein tumhein koi bartari hum par hasil ho gayi ho. Balkah hamare khayal se tum sab ke sab jhoote hain. Neki aur salahiyat aur ibadat par jo wade tum hamein akhirat mulk ke de rahe hain hamare nazdeek toh yeh sab bhi jhooti baatein hain. In kuffar ki be-aqli toh dekhiye agar haq ke qubool karne wale nichle tabaqe ke log huwe toh kya is se haq ki shaan ghat gayi? Haq haq hi hai khwah is ke manne wale bare log hon khwah chhote log hon. Balkah haq baat yeh hai ke haq ki pairwi karne wale hi shareef log hain. Chahe woh maskeen muflis hi hon aur haq se ro-gardani karne wale hain zaleel aur razeel hain go woh ghani maldar aur ameer umra hon. Haan yeh waqie hai ke sachai ki aawaz ko pehle pehal ghareeb maskeen log hi qubool karte hain aur ameer kabeer log naak bhon charhane lagte hain. Farman-e-Quran hai ke tujh se pehle jis jis basti mein hamare anbiya aaye wahan ke bare logon ne yahi kaha ke hum ne apne baap-dadon ko jis deen par paya hai hum toh unhi ki khosha-cheeni karte rahenge. Shah-e-Room Herqal ne jo Abu Sufyan se poocha tha ke shareef logon ne is ki tabadari ki hai ya zaeef logon ne? Toh us ne yahi jawab diya tha ke zaeefon ne jis par Herqal ne kaha tha ke rasoolon ke tabad-dar yahi log hote hain. Haq ki fori qubooliyat bhi koi aib ki baat nahi, haq ki wazahat ke baad raye fikar ki zaroorat hi kya hai? Balkah har aqalmand ka kaam yahi hai ke haq ko manne mein sabaqat aur jaldi kare. Is mein tamul karna jahalat aur kund-zehni hai. Allah ke tamam paighambar bahut wazeh aur saaf aur khuli hui dalelein le kar aate hain.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke maine jise bhi Islam ki taraf bulaya us mein kuch na kuch jhujhak zaroor payi siwaye Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ke ke unhon ne koi taraddud-o-tammul na kiya, wazih cheez ko dekhte hi foran be-jhujhak qabul kar liya. Un ka teesra itraaz "hum koi bartari tum mein nahi dekhte" yeh bhi un ke andhe pan ki wajah se hai. Apni un ki aankhein aur kaan na hon aur ek maujood cheez ka inkaar karein toh fi-al-waqie us ka na hona sabit nahi ho sakta. Yeh toh na haq ko dekhein na haq ko sunein balki apne shakk mein ghote lagate rehte hain. Apni jahalat mein dabkiyan marte rehte hain. Jhoote muftari khaali haath, razeel aur nuqsanon wale hain.

Bila ujrat khair-khwah se narwa suluk:

Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ne apni kaum ko jawab diya ke sachi nobat yaqeen aur wazeh cheez mere paas toh mere Rab ki taraf se aa chuki hai. Bahut badi rahmat-o-nemat Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ata farmayi aur woh tum se poshida rahi, tum use na dekh sake, na tum ne us ki qadr-dani ki, na use pehchana, balki be-soche samjhe tum ne use dhakke de diye, use jhutlane lag gaye. Ab batao ke tumhari is na-pasandidagi ki halat mein main kaise yeh kar sakta hoon ke tumhein is ka mataht bana doon?

Dawat-e-Haq sab ke liye yaksan hai. Aap apni kaum se farmate hain ki main jo kuch naseehat tumhein kar raha hoon, jitni khair-khwahī tumhārī karta hoon, uski koi ujrat toh tumse nahi mangta, meri ujrat toh Allah ke zimme hai. Tum jo mujhse kehte ho ki in ghareeb maskeen iman walon ko main dhakke de doon, mujhse toh yeh kabhi nahi hone ka. Yahi talab An-Hazrat ﷺ se bhi ki gai thi, jiske jawab mein yeh aayat utri: 
(وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدٰوةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَهٗ) (6۔ Al-An'am: 52) 
Yaani subh-o-sham apne Rab ke pukarne walon ko apni majlis se na nikal. Aur aayat mein hai: 
(وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُوْلُوْٓا اَهٰٓؤُلَاۗءِ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِنَا ۭ اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بالشّٰكِرِيْنَ) (6۔ Al-An'am: 53) 
Isi tarah humne ek ko doosre se aazma liya aur woh kehne lage ki kya yahi woh log hain jin par hum sab ko chhod kar Allah ka fazl nazil hua? Kya Allah Ta'ala shukar guzaaron ko nahi jaanta?

Mera paigham Allah wahdahu la sharika ki ibadat hai, aap farmate hain main sirf Rasulullah hoon, Allah wahdahu la sharika lahu ki ibadat aur tauheed ki taraf uske farman ke mutabiq tum sab ko bulata hoon. Isse meri murad tumse maal samaitna nahi. Har bare chhote ke liye meri dawat-e-aam hai jo qubool karega nijat payega. Allah ke khazano ke her pher ki mujh mein qudrat nahi. Main ghaib nahi janta haan jo baat Allah mujhe maloom kara de maloom ho jati hai. Main farishta hone ka daweedar nahi hoon. Balki ek insan hoon jis ki ta'eed Allah ki taraf se mojzoon se ho rahi hai. Jinhein tum razeel aur zaleel samajh rahe ho. Main to iska qayil nahi ke unhein Allah ke haan unki nekiyon ka badla nahi milega. Unke batin ka haal bhi mujhe maloom nahi Allah hi ko iska ilm hai. Agar zahir ki tarah batin mein bhi imandar hain to unhein Allah ke haan zaroor nekiyan milengi, jo unke anjam ki burai ko kahe usne zulm kiya aur jahalat ki baat kahi.

Qaum-e-Nuh ki ujlat pasandi ki himaqat

Qaum-e-Nuh ki ujlat bayan ho rahi hai ke azab maang baithe. Kehne lage bas hujjatein toh hum ne bohot si sun lein. Aakhri faisla hamara yeh hai ke hum toh teri tabedari nahi karne ke ab agar tu sacha hai toh dua kar ke hum par azab le aao. Aap ne jawab diya ke yeh bhi mere bas ki baat nahi Allah ke haath hai. Usse koi aajiz karne wala nahi agar Allah ka irada hi tumhari gumrahi aur barbadi ka hai toh phir waqai meri nasihat besood hai. Sab ka malik Allah hi hai tamam kaamo ki takmeel usi ke haath hai. Mutasarrif, hakim, aadil, ghair zalim, faislo ke amr ka malik, ibtida paida karne wala, phir lautane wala, duniya o aakhirat ka tanha malik wahi hai. Sari makhlooq ko usi ki taraf lautna hai.

Kuffar ka ilzam aur Rasoolullah ﷺ ka jawab. Yeh darmiyani kalam is qisse ke beech mein iski ta'eed aur taqreer hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne akhiri Rasool ﷺ se farmata hai ke yeh kuffar tujh par is Quran ke az-khud ghad lene ka ilzam laga rahe hain toh jawab de ke agar aisa hai toh mera gunah mujh par hai, main janta hoon ke Allah ke azab kaise kuch hain? Phir kaise mumkin hai ke main Allah par jhoot iftira ghad loon? Haan, apne gunahon ke zimmedaar tum aap ho.

Qaum-e-Nuh ka manga huwa azaab usay mila. Qaum-e-Nuh ne jab azaabon ki maang jaldi machai toh Aap ne Allah se dua ki: "Ilahi zameen par kisi kafir ko rehta basta na chhod. Parvardigar! Main aajiz aa gaya hoon, tu meri madad kar." Usi waqt wahi aayi ke jo iman la chuke hain, un ke siwa aur koi ab iman na layega, toh un par afsos na kar na un ka koi aisa khaas khayal kar. Hamare dekhte hi hamari taleem ke mutabiq ek kashti tayar kar aur ab zalimon ke bare mein hum se koi baat-cheet na kar, hum un ka dubo dena muqarrar kar chuke hain. 

Ba'z salaf kehte hain hukm huwa ke lakdiyan kaat kar sukha kar takhte bana lo. Is mein ek sau saal guzar gaye, phir mukammal tayari mein sau saal aur nikal gaye, ek qaul hai chaalis saal lage, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq Taurat se naqal karte hain ke saag ki lakdi ki yeh kashti tayar hui, is ka tool assi (80) haath tha aur arz pachaas (50) haath ka tha. Andar baahar se roghan kiya gaya tha, paani kaatne ke par-purzey bhi the. Qatadah ka qaul hai ke lambai teen sau haath ki thi. Ibn Abbas ka farman hai ke tool barah sau haath ka tha aur chaudai chhe sau haath ki thi. Kaha gaya hai ke tool do hazaar haath aur chaudai ek sau haath ki thi, Wallahu A'lam. 

Is ki androoni onchai tees haath ki thi, is mein teen darjay the, har darja das haath uncha tha. Sab se niche ke hisse mein chaupaye aur jangli janwar the. Darmiyan ke hisse mein insan the aur upar ke hisse mein parinday the. Un mein chota darwaza tha, upar se bilkul band thi. 

Ibn Jareer ne ek ghareeb asar Abdullah bin Abbas se zikr kiya hai ke hawariyon ne Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (Alaihis Salam) se darkhwast ki ke agar aap buhkum-e-Ilahi kisi aise murdah ko jalate jis ne kashti-e-Nuh dekhi ho toh hamein is se malumat hotin. Aap unhein lekar ek teelay par pahunch kar wahan ki mitti uthai aur farmaya: "Jaante ho yeh kaun hai?" Unhon ne kaha ke Allah aur us ke Rasool ko hi ilm hai. Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh pandli hai Ham bin Nuh ki." Phir aap ne ek lakdi us teelay par maar kar farmaya: "Allah ke hukm se uth khada ho." Usi waqt ek budha sa aadmi apne sar se mitti jhadta huwa uth khada huwa. 

Aap ne us se poocha: "Kya tu budhape mein mara tha?" Us ne kaha: "Nahi, mara toh tha jawani mein, lekin ab dil par dehshat baithi ke qayamat qaim ho gayi, is dehshat ne budha kar diya." Aap ne farmaya: "Achha! Hazrat Nuh ki kashti ki baabat apni malumat bayan karo." Us ne kaha: "Woh barah sau haath lambi aur chhe sau haath chaudi thi, teen darjon ki thi. Ek mein janwar aur chaupaye the, doosre mein insan, teesre mein parind. Jab janwaron ka gobar phail gaya toh Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Nuh ki taraf wahi bheji ke haathi ki dum hilaao. Aap ke hilate hi us se khanzeer nar-mada nikal aaye aur woh mail khane lage. Choohon ne jab us ke takhte katarne shuru kiye toh hukm huwa ke sher ki peshani par ungli laga. Us se billi ka joda nikla aur choohon ki taraf lapka."

Isi liye woh gharon se maanoos nahi hota. Phir aap ne kabootar ko bheja woh apni choonch mein zaitoon ke darakht ka patta lekar aaya aur apne panjon mein khushk mitti laya isse maloom ho gaya keh shehar doob chuke hain. Uske jawab mein Hazrat Noh (A.S) farmate achha dil khush kar lo waqt aa raha hai keh iska poora badla le liya jaye. Us se billi ka joda nikla aur choohon ki taraf lapka." 

Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ne sawal kiya ke Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ko shahron ke gharqab hone ka ilm kaise ho gaya?

Hamare dekhte hi hamari taleem ke mutabiq ek kashti tayar kar aur ab zalimon ke bare mein hum se koi baat-cheet na kar, hum un ka dubo dena muqarrar kar chuke hain. 

Ba'z salaf kehte hain hukm huwa ke lakdiyan kaat kar sukha kar takhte bana lo. Is mein ek sau saal guzar gaye, phir mukammal tayari mein sau saal aur nikal gaye, ek qaul hai chaalis saal lage, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq Taurat se naqal karte hain ke saag ki lakdi ki yeh kashti tayar hui, is ka tool assi (80) haath tha aur arz pachaas (50) haath ka tha. Andar baahar se roghan kiya gaya tha, paani kaatne ke par-purzey bhi the. Qatadah ka qaul hai ke lambai teen sau haath ki thi. Ibn Abbas ka farman hai ke tool barah sau haath ka tha aur chaudai chhe sau haath ki thi. Kaha gaya hai ke tool do hazaar haath aur chaudai ek sau haath ki thi, Wallahu A'lam. 

Is ki androoni onchai tees haath ki thi, is mein teen darjay the, har darja das haath uncha tha. Sab se niche ke hisse mein chaupaye aur jangli janwar the. Darmiyan ke hisse mein insan the aur upar ke hisse mein parinday the. Un mein chota darwaza tha, upar se bilkul band thi.

Qoum-e-Nuh par Azab-e-Ilahi ka nuzool: Hasb-e-farman-e-Rabi aasman se musla dhaar lagataar barish barasne lagi aur zameen se bhi pani ubalne laga aur saari zameen pani se bhar gayi aur jahan tak manzoor-e-Rabb tha pani bhar gaya aur Hazrat Nuh ko Rabb-ul-Alameen ne apni nigahon ke samne chalne wali kashti par sawar kar diya. Aur kafiroon ko unke kaifar-e-kirdar ko pohncha diya. Tannoor ke ubalne se baqool Ibn Abbas yeh matlab hai ke ruye zameen se chashme phoot pare yahan tak ke aag ki jagah tannoor mein se bhi pani ubal para. Yahi qoul jamhoor-e-salaf-o-khalaf ka hai. Hazrat Ali se marwi hai ke tannoor subh ka nikalna aur fajr ka roshan hona hai yaani subh ki roshni aur fajr ki chamak lekin zyada ghalib pehla qoul hai. Mujahid aur Sha'bi kehte hain yeh tannoor Koofey mein tha. Ibn Abbas se marwi hai Hind mein ek nehar hai. Qatada kehte hain Jazira mein ek nehar hai jise Ain-ul-Warda kehte hain. Lekin yeh sab aqwal ghareeb hain. Al-Gharaz in alamaaton ke zahir hote hi Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ko Allah ka hukm hua ke apne sath kashti mein jandar makhlooq mein se har qism ka ek ek joda nar mada sawar kar lo. Kaha gaya hai ke ghair jandar ke liye bhi yahi hukm tha. Jaisa nabatat. Kaha gaya hai ke parindon mein sab se pehle durrah kashti mein aya aur sab se aakhri mein gadha sawar hone laga. Iblees us ki dum mein latak gaya jab uske do agle paon kashti mein aa gaye uska apna dhar uthana chaha to na utha saka kyunke dum par us maloon ka bojh tha. Hazrat Nuh jaldi kar rahe the yeh bahteera chahta tha magar pichle paon charh nahi sakte the. Aakhir aap ne farmaya aaj tere sath Iblees bhi ho aya tab woh charh gaya aur Iblees bhi uske sath hi aya. Baaz salaf kehte hain ke sher ko apne sath le jana mushkil ho gaya, aakhir use bukhaar charh aya tab use sawar kar liya. Ibn Abi Hatim ki hadees mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ne jab tamam maweshi apni kashti mein sawar kar liye to logon ne kaha sher ki maujoodgi mein yeh maweshi kaise aaram se reh sakenge? Pas Allah Ta'ala ne use bukhaar daal diya. Is se pehle zameen par yeh bemaari na thi. Phir logon ne chuhe ki shikayat ki yeh hamara khana aur deegar cheezein kharab kar rahe hain to Allah ke hukm se sher ki chheenk mein se ek billi nikli jis se chuhe dabak kar kone khadre mein baith rahe. Hazrat Nuh ko hukm hua ke apne ghar walon ko bhi apne sath kashti mein bitha lo magar un mein se jo iman nahi laye unhe sath na lena. Aap ka larka Ham bhi unhin kafiroon mein tha woh alag ho gaya. Ya aap ki biwi ke woh bhi Allah ke Rasool ki munkar thi aur teri qoum ke tamam musalmano ko bhi apne sath bitha le lekin un musalmano ki tadad bohat kam thi. Saadhay no so saal ke qiyam ki taweel muddat mein aap par bohat kam log iman laye the, Ibn Abbas farmate hain kul assi (80) aadmi the jin mein auratein bhi thin, Ka'ab (Rahimahullah) farmate hain sab behatar (72) ashخاص the.

Ek qaul hai sirf das (10) aadmi thay, ek qaul hai Hazrat Noh (A.S) thay aur un ke teen larke thay Sam, Ham, Yafis aur chaar aurtein thin. Teen to un teeno ki biwiyan aur chauthi Ham ki biwi aur kaha gaya hai ke khud Hazrat Noh ki biwi. Lekin is mein nazar hai, zahir yeh hai ke Hazrat Noh ki biwi halak hone walon mein halak hui. Is liye ke woh apni qaum ke deen par hi thi, to jis tarah Lut (A.S) ki biwi qaum ke saath halak hui usi tarah yeh bhi. Wallahu A'lamu wa Ahkam.

Kashti-e-Nuh par kaun kaun sawar huwa? Hazrat Nuh (A.S) jinhein apne sath le jana chahte the unse farmaya ke aao is mein sawar ho jao is ka pani par chalna Allah ke naam ki barkat se hai aur usi tarah is ka akhri thahrao bhi usi pak naam se hai. Aik qirat mein "majraha wa mursaha" bhi hai. Yehi Allah ka aap ko hukum tha ke jab tum aur tumhare sathi theek tarah baith jao to kehna: (Al-hamdu lillahillazi najjana minal-qaumiz-zalimin) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 28) aur ye bhi dua karna ke: (Anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khairul-munzilin) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 29) Is liye mustahab hai ke tamam kamon ke shuru mein Bismillah parh li jaye khwah kashti par sawar hona ho, khwah janwar par sawar hona ho, jaise farman-e-bari hai ke usi Allah ne tumhare liye tamam joray paida kiye hain aur kashtiyan aur chaupaye tumhari sawari ke liye paida kiye hain ke tum un ki peeth par sawari karo, al-akh. Hadis mein bhi is ki takeed aur ragbat aayi hai, Surah Zukhruf mein is ka pura bayan hoga Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Tabarani mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain meri ummat ke liye doobne se bachao un ke is qaul mein hai sawar hote hue keh len (Ayat: Bismillahi-l-Maliki wa ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrihi) puri: (Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha inna Rabbi la-Ghafurur-Rahim) (11. Hud: 41). Is dua ke akhir mein Allah ka wasf Ghafoor-o-Rahim is liye laye ke kafiron ki saza ke muqable mein muminon par rehmat aur shafqat ka izhar ho. Jaise farman hai tera Rab jald saza karne wala aur sath hi Ghafoor-o-Rahim bhi hai. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa inna Rabbaka la-zu maghfiratin lin-nasi 'ala zulmihim wa inna Rabbaka la-shadidul-'iqab) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 6) Yani tera parwardigar logon ke gunahon ko bakhshne wala bhi hai aur sakht saza dene wala bhi hai. Aur bhi bahut si ayatein hain jin mein rehmat aur intiqam ka bayan mila jula hai. 

Pani ruye zamin par phir gaya hai, kisi unche se unche pahar ki bulandi se buland choti bhi dikhai nahi deti balke paharon se upar pandrah hath aur baqaule assim mil upar ko ho gaya hai bawajud is ke kashti-e-Nuh bi-hukmil-Ilahi barabar sahi taur par ja rahi hai. Khud Allah is ka muhafiz hai aur woh khas is ki inayat aur mehr hai. Jaise farman hai: (Inna lamma taghal-mau hamalnakum fil-jariyah) (69. Al-Haqqah: 11) Yani pani mein tughyani ke waqt hum ne aap tumhein kashti mein charha liya ke hum ise tumhare liye naseehat banayein aur yaad rakhne wale kaan ise yaad rakh len aur ayat mein hai ke hum ne tumhein is takhton wali kashti par sawar karaya aur apni hifazat mein par utara aur kafiron ko un ke kufr ka anjam dikha diya aur ise ek nishaan bana diya kya ab bhi koi hai jo ibrat hasil kare?

Us waqt Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ne apne sahibzade ko bulaya, yeh aap ke chauthe larke the, is ka naam Ham tha, yeh kafir tha, ise aap ne kashti mein sawar hone ke waqt iman ki aur apne sath baith jaane ki hidayat ki taake doobne se aur kafiroon ke azab se bach jaye. Magar is badniyat ne jawab diya ke nahi mujhe is ki zaroorat nahi, main pahad par chadh kar tufan-e-baran se bach jaunga. Ek Israeli riwayat mein hai ke us ne shishe ki kashti banayi thi, wallahu aalam. Quran mein to yeh hai ke us ne yeh samjha ke yeh tufan pahado’n ki chotiyon tak nahi pahunchne ka, jab main ja pahunchunga to yeh pani mera kya bigade ga? Is par Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ne jawab diya ke aaj azab-e-ilahi se kahin panah nahi, wahi bachega jis par Allah ka raham ho. Yahan 'asim ma'sum ke ma'ane mein hai jaise ta'im mat'um ke ma'ane mein aur ka'im maksur ke ma'ane mein aaya hai. Yeh baatein ho hi rahi thi ke ek mauj aayi aur pisr-e-nuh ko le doobi.

Al-Haqqah: 11) Yani pani mein tughyani ke waqt hum ne aap tumhein kashti mein charha liya ke hum ise tumhare liye naseehat banayein aur yaad rakhne wale kaan ise yaad rakh len aur ayat mein hai ke hum ne tumhein is takhton wali kashti par sawar karaya aur apni hifazat mein par utara aur kafiron ko un ke kufr ka anjam dikha diya aur ise ek nishaan bana diya kya ab bhi koi hai jo ibrat hasil kare?

Us waqt Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ne apne sahibzade ko bulaya, yeh aap ke chauthe larke the, is ka naam Ham tha, yeh kafir tha, ise aap ne kashti mein sawar hone ke waqt iman ki aur apne sath baith jaane ki hidayat ki taake doobne se aur kafiroon ke azab se bach jaye. Magar is badniyat ne jawab diya ke nahi mujhe is ki zaroorat nahi, main pahad par chadh kar tufan-e-baran se bach jaunga. Ek Israeli riwayat mein hai ke us ne shishe ki kashti banayi thi, wallahu aalam. Quran mein to yeh hai ke us ne yeh samjha ke yeh tufan pahado’n ki chotiyon tak nahi pahunchne ka, jab main ja pahunchunga to yeh pani mera kya bigade ga? Is par Hazrat Nuh (Alaihis Salam) ne jawab diya ke aaj azab-e-ilahi se kahin panah nahi, wahi bachega jis par Allah ka raham ho. Yahan 'asim ma'sum ke ma'ane mein hai jaise ta'im mat'um ke ma'ane mein aur ka'im maksur ke ma'ane mein aaya hai. Yeh baatein ho hi rahi thi ke ek mauj aayi aur pisr-e-nuh ko le doobi.

Kashti-e-Nuh par kaun kaun sawar huwa? Hazrat Nuh (A.S) jinhein apne sath le jana chahte the unse farmaya ke aao is mein sawar ho jao is ka pani par chalna Allah ke naam ki barkat se hai aur usi tarah is ka akhri thahrao bhi usi pak naam se hai. Aik qirat mein "majraha wa mursaha" bhi hai. Yehi Allah ka aap ko hukum tha ke jab tum aur tumhare sathi theek tarah baith jao to kehna: (Al-hamdu lillahillazi najjana minal-qaumiz-zalimin) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 28) aur ye bhi dua karna ke: (Anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khairul-munzilin) (23. Al-Mu'minun: 29) Is liye mustahab hai ke tamam kamon ke shuru mein Bismillah parh li jaye khwah kashti par sawar hona ho, khwah janwar par sawar hona ho, jaise farman-e-bari hai ke usi Allah ne tumhare liye tamam joray paida kiye hain aur kashtiyan aur chaupaye tumhari sawari ke liye paida kiye hain ke tum un ki peeth par sawari karo, al-akh. Hadis mein bhi is ki takeed aur ragbat aayi hai, Surah Zukhruf mein is ka pura bayan hoga Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Tabarani mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain meri ummat ke liye doobne se bachao un ke is qaul mein hai sawar hote hue keh len (Ayat: Bismillahi-l-Maliki wa ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrihi) puri: (Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha inna Rabbi la-Ghafurur-Rahim) (11. Hud: 41). Is dua ke akhir mein Allah ka wasf Ghafoor-o-Rahim is liye laye ke kafiron ki saza ke muqable mein muminon par rehmat aur shafqat ka izhar ho. Jaise farman hai tera Rab jald saza karne wala aur sath hi Ghafoor-o-Rahim bhi hai. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa inna Rabbaka la-zu maghfiratin lin-nasi 'ala zulmihim wa inna Rabbaka la-shadidul-'iqab) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 6) Yani tera parwardigar logon ke gunahon ko bakhshne wala bhi hai aur sakht saza dene wala bhi hai. Aur bhi bahut si ayatein hain jin mein rehmat aur intiqam ka bayan mila jula hai.

Tufan-e-Nuh A.S ki roodad:
Roue zamin ke sab log us tufan mein jo dar-haqiqat Ghazab-e-Ilahi aur mazloom paighambar ki bad-dua ka azab tha, gharq ho gaye. Us waqt Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ne zamin ko us pani ke nigal lene ka hukm diya jo us ka ugla hua aur aasman ka barsaya hua tha. Sath hi aasman ko bhi pani barsane se ruk jaane ka hukm ho gaya. Pani ghasatne laga aur kaam poora ho gaya ya'ani tamam kafir nabood ho gaye, sirf kashti wale momin hi bache. Kashti Ba-Hukm-e-Rabi Judi par ruki. 

Mujahid kehte hain yeh jazira mein ek pahaad hai, sab pahaad dobu diye gaye the aur yeh pahaad ba-wajah apni aajizi aur tawazu ke gharq hone se bach raha tha, yahin kashti-e-Nuh langar-andaz hui. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain mahine bhar tak yahin lagi rahi aur sab utar gaye aur kashti logon ki ibrat ke liye yahin sabit-o-salim rakhi rahi yahan tak ke is ummat ke awwal logon ne bhi ise dekh liya. Halanki is ke baad ki behtareen aur mazboot saikron kashtiyan banin bigadin balki raakh aur khaak ho gayin. 

Zahhak farmate hain Judi naam ka pahaad Mosul mein hai. Baaz kehte hain Toor pahaad ko hi Judi bhi kehte hain. Zar bin Hubaish ko Abu Ab Kunda se dakhil ho kar dayin taraf ke zawiyah mein namaz bakasrat padhte hue dekh kar Nuba bin Salim ne pucha ke aap jo jumma ke din barabar yahan aksar namaz padha karte hain is ki kya wajah hai? To aap ne jawab diya ke kashti-e-Nuh yahin lagi thi. 

Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Nuh A.S ke sath kashti mein baal-bachon samit kul assi (80) aadmi the. Ek sau pachas din tak woh sab kashti mein hi rahe. Allah Ta'ala ne kashti ka munh Makkah Sharif ki taraf kar diya. Yahan woh chaalis din tak Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf karti rahi. Phir ise Allah Ta'ala ne Judi ki taraf rawana kar diya, wahan woh thehar gayi. 

Hazrat Nuh A.S ne kowwe ko bheja ke woh khushki ki khabar laye. Woh ek murdar ke khane mein lag gaya aur dair laga di. Aap ne ek kabootar ko bheja, woh apni chonch mein zaitoon ke darakhat ka patta aur panjon mein mitti lekar wapas aaya. Is se Hazrat Nuh A.S ne samajh liya ke pani sookh gaya hai aur zamin zahir ho gayi hai. Pas aap Judi ke niche utre aur wahin ek basti ki bina daal di jise Samanin kehte hain. 

Ek din subah ko jab log jaate to har ek ki zaban badli hui thi. Aisi zabanen bolne lage jin mein sab se aala aur behtareen arbi zaban thi. Ek ko dusre ka kalam samajhna muhal ho gaya. Nuh A.S ko Allah Ta'ala ne sab zabanen maloom kara din, aap un sab ke darmiyan mutarjim the. Ek ka matlab dusre ko samjha dete the. 

Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar farmate hain ke kashti-e-Nuh mashriq-o-maghrib ke darmiyan chal-phir rahi thi phir Judi par thehar gayi. 

Hazrat Qatada wagairah farmate hain Rajab ki daswin tarikh musalman is mein sawar hue the, panch mah tak isi mein rahe, unhe lekar kashti Judi par mahine bhar tak thehri rahi. Aakhir Muharram ke Ashura ke din woh sab is mein se utre. Isi qism ki ek marfoo' hadis bhi Ibn Jarir mein hai, unhon ne is din roza bhi rakha. Wallahu A'lam.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Nabi ﷺ ne chand yahudiyon ko Ashoora ke din roza rakhe hue dekh kar un se is ka sabab daryaft farmaya to unhon ne kaha isi din Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa ؑ aur Bani Israel ko darya se par utara tha aur Firon aur us ki qaum ko dobo diya tha. Aur isi din kashti-e-Noh Judi par lagi thi. Pas in donon paighambaron ne Shukr-e-Ilahi ka roza is din rakha tha. Aap ne yeh sun kar farmaya phir Musa ؑ ka sab se zyada haqdar main hoon aur is din ke rozey ka main zyada mustahiq hoon. Pas Aap ne is din ka roza rakha aur apne ashab se farmaya ke tum mein se jo aaj rozey se ho woh to apna roza poora kare aur jo nashta kar chuka ho woh bhi baqi din kuch na khaye. Yeh riwayat is sanad se to gharib hai lekin is ke ba'z hisse ke shahid sahih hadith mein bhi maujood hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke zalimon ko khasara, halakat aur Rahmat-e-Haq se doori hui. Woh sab halak hue un mein se ek bhi baqi na bacha. Tafsir Ibn Jarir aur Tafsir Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar Allah Ta'ala qaum-e-Noh mein se kisi par bhi raham karne wala hota to is bachche ki maan par raham karta. Hazrat Noh apni qaum mein saadhay nau sau saal tak thahare Aap ne ek darakht boya tha jo sau saal tak barhta aur bara hota raha phir ise kaat kar takhtay bana kar kashti banani shuru ki. Kafir log mazaq urate ke yeh is khushki mein kashti kaise chalayenge? Aap jawab dete the ke anqareeb apni ankhon se dekh lo ge jab Aap bana chuke aur pani zameen se ublne aur aasman se barasne laga aur galiyan aur rastay pani se doobne lage to is bachche ki maan jis ko apne is bachche se ghayat darje ki mohabbat thi woh ise le kar pahar ki taraf chali gayi aur jaldi jaldi is par charhna shuru kiya, tihai hisse par charh gayi lekin jab us ne dekha ke pani wahan bhi pucha to aur oopar ko charhi. Do tihai ko pahunchi jab pani wahan bhi pahuncha toh us ne choti par ja kar dam liya lekin pani wahan bhi pahunch gaya jab gardan gardan pani charh gaya toh us ne apne bachche ko apne donon hathon mein le kar ooncha utha liya lekin pani wahan bhi pahuncha aur maan bachcha donon gharq ho gaye. Pas agar is din koi kafir bhi bachne wala hota to Allah Ta'ala is bachche ki maan par raham karta. Yeh hadith is sanad se gharib hai ke Ka'b Ahbar, Mujahid aur Ibn Jubeir se bhi is bachche aur us ki maan ka yahi qissa marwi hai.

Noh Alaihis Salam ki apne bete ke liye najat ki dua aur jawab:

Yad rahe ke yeh dua Hazrat Noh Alaihis Salam ki mahz is gharz se thi ke aap ko sahi taur par apne dobe hue larke ka haal maloom ho jaye. Kehte hain ke Parwardigar yeh bhi zahir hai ke mera larka mere ahl mein se tha aur mere ahl ko bachane ka tera wada tha aur yeh bhi namumkin hai ke tera wada ghalat ho. Phir yeh mera bacha kuffar ke sath kaise gharq kar diya gaya? 

Jawab mila ke teri jis ahl ko najat dene ka mera wada tha un mein tera yeh bacha dakhil na tha, mera yeh wada imandaron ki najat ka tha. Main keh chuka tha ke (Wa ahlaka illa man sabaqa alaihil-qawlu minhum wa la tukhatibni fil-lazina zalamu innahum mughraqun) (Surah Al-Muminun: 27). Yaani tere ahl ko bhi to kashti mein charha le magar jis par meri baat barh chuki hai woh bujhaye apne kufr ke unhi mein se tha jo mere sabiq ilm mein kufr wale aur doobne wale muqarrar ho chuke the. 

Yeh bhi yad rahe ke jin ba'az logon ne kaha hai yeh darasal Hazrat Noh Alaihis Salam ka larka tha hi nahi kyunke aap ke batan se na tha, balki badkari se tha aur ba'az ne kaha hai ke yeh aap ki biwi ka agle ghar ka larka tha. Yeh dono qaul ghalat hain, bohot se buzrugon ne saf lafzon mein ise ghalat kaha hai balki Ibn Abbas aur bohot se salaf se manqool hai ke kisi nabi ki biwi ne kabhi zina kari nahi ki. 

Pas yahan is farmaan se ke woh tere ahl mein se nahi, yahi matlab hai ke tere jis ahl ki najat ka mera wada hai yeh un mein se nahi. Yahi baat sach hai aur yahi qaul asli hai. Iske siwa aur taraf jana mahz ghalati hai aur zahir khata hai. Allah Ta'ala ki ghairat is baat ko qubool nahi kar sakti ke apne kisi nabi ke ghar mein zaniya aurat de. 

Khayal farmaiye ke Hazrat Aisha R.A ki nisbat jinhone bohotan bazi ki thi un par Allah Ta'ala kis qadar ghazabnak hua. Is larke ke ahl mein se nikal jaane ki wajah khud Quran ne bayan farma di hai ke uske amal naik na the. Ikrimah farmate hain ek qirat (Innahu amala ghaira salih) hai. Musnad ki hadith mein hai Hazrat Asma bint Yazid farmati hain maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko (Innahu amalun ghairu salih) (Surah Hud: 46) parhte suna hai aur (Qul ya ibadiyal-lazina asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah, innallaha yaghfiruz-zunuba jami'a, innahu huwal-ghafoor-ur-raheem) (Surah Az-Zumar: 53) parhte suna hai. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se sawal hua ke (Fa khanata huma) ka kya matlab hai? Aap ne farmaya isse murad zina nahi balki Hazrat Noh Alaihis Salam ki biwi ki khiyanat to yeh thi ke logon se kehti thi yeh majnoon hai aur Hazrat Lut ki biwi ki khiyanat yeh thi ke jo mehman aap ke haan aate apni qaum ko khabar kar deti. Phir aap ne farmaya Allah sacha hai usne ise Hazrat Noh ka larka farma diya hai. Pas woh yaqinan Hazrat Noh ka sabit-un-nasab larka hi tha.

Dekho Allah farmata hai (Wa nada Nuhun rabbahu) aur yeh bhi yaad rahe ke ba'az ulama ka qaul hai ke kisi nabi ki biwi ne kabhi zina-kari nahi ki, aisa hi Hazrat Mujahid se marwi hai. Aur yahi Ibn Jarir ka pasandeeda hai aur fi-waqai theek aur sahi baat bhi yahi hai.

Tufan-e-Noh ka akhri manzar kashti tehri aur Allah ka salam aap par aur aap ke tamam momin sathiyon par aur unki aulad mein se Qayamat tak jo imandar aane wale hain sab par nazil huwa. Sath hi kafiron ke duniyawi fayde se mustafid hone aur phir azab mein giraftar hone ka bhi elan huwa. Pas yeh ayat Qayamat tak ke mominon ki salamati aur barkat aur kafiron ki saza par mabni hai. Imam Ibn Ishaq ka bayan hai ki jab Janab-e-Bari Jalla Shanuhu ne tufan band karne ka irada farma liya toh ro-e-zamin par ek hawa bhej di jis ne pani ko sakin kar diya aur uska ubalna band ho gaya, sath hi asman ke darwaze bhi jo ab tak pani barsa rahe the band kar diye gaye. Zamin ko pani ke jazb kar lene ka hukm ho gaya usi waqt pani kam hona shuru ho gaya aur baqoul Ahl-e-Taurat ke satwein mahine ki satrahwein tarikh kashti-e-Noh "Judi" par lagi. Duswein mahine ki pehli tarikh ko paharon ki chotiyan khul gayin. Uske chalis din ke bad kashti ke rozan pani ke upar dikhai dene lage. Phir aap ne koye ko pani ki tehqiq ke liye bheja lekin woh palat kar na aaya, aap ne kabutar ko bheja jo wapas aaya. Apne paon rakhne ko use jagah na mili, aap ne apne hath par lekar use andar le liya, phir saat din ke bad use dobara bheja. Sham ko woh wapas aaya, apni chonch mein zaitun ka patta liye huwe tha, isse Allah ke nabi ne maloom kar liya ki pani zamin se kuch hi uncha reh gaya hai. Phir saat din ke bad bheja ab ki martaba woh na lota toh aap ne samajh liya ki zamin bilkul khushk ho chuki hai. Al-gharz poore ek saal ke bad Hazrat Noh (Alaihis Salam) ne kashti ka sarposh uthaya aur awaz aayi ki "Aye Noh! Hamari nazil karda salamati ke sath ab utr aao" al-kh.

Yeh tarikh-e-mazi wahi ke zariye bayan ki gayi hai. Qissa-e-Noh aur usi qisam ke guzishtah waqiat woh hain jo tere samne nahi huwe lekin bazariya-e-wahi ke hum tujhe unki khabar kar rahe hain aur tu logon ke samne unki haqeeqat is tarah khol raha hai ke goya un ke hone ke waqt tu wahin mojood tha. Is se pehle na to tujhe hi unki koi khabar thi na teri kaum mein se koi aur un ka ilm rakhta tha. Ke kisi ko bhi guman ho ke shayad tu ne is se seekh liye hon. Pas saaf baat hai ke yeh Allah ki wahi se tujhe maloom huwe aur theek usi tarah jis tarah agli kitabon mein mojood hain. Pas ab tujhe un ke satane jhutlane par sabr-o-bardasht karna chahiye hum teri madad par hain tujhe aur tere tabeadaron ko un par ghalba denge, anjam ke lihaz se tum hi ghalib rahoge, yehi tareeqa aur paigambaron ka bhi raha.

Qoum-e-Hud ki Tarikh:

Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Hud (Alaihis Salam) ko un ki qoum ki taraf apna Rasul (ﷺ) bana kar bheja, unhon ne qoum ko Allah ki touheed ki dawat di aur is ke siva auron ki pooja paat se roka. Aur bataya ke jin ko tum poojte ho un ki pooja khud tum ne ghar li hai, balke un ke naam aur wajood tumhare khayali dhakosle hain. In se kaha ke main apni nasihat ka koi badla aur muawza tum se nahi chahta, mera sawab mera Rab mujhe dega jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai. Kya tum yeh moti si baat bhi aql mein nahi late ke yeh duniya akhirat ki bhalayi ki tumhe rah dikhane wala hai aur tum se koi ujrat talab karne wala nahi. Tum istighfar mein lag jao, guzashta gunahon ki muafyi Allah Ta'ala se talab karo aur tauba karo, ayindah ke liye gunahon se ruk jao. Yeh dono baatein jis mein hon Allah Ta'ala us ki rozi us par asaan karta hai, uska kaam us par sahal karta hai, us ki nishani ki hifazat karta hai. Suno aisa karne se tum par barishein barabar umda aur zyada barsein gi aur tumhari quwwat-o-taqat mein din dooni raat choguni barkatein hongi. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jo shakhs istighfar ko lazim pakad le Allah Ta'ala use har mushkil se najat deta hai, har tangi se kushadagi ata farmata hai aur rozi to usi jagah se pohanchata hai jo khud us ke khwab-o-khayal mein bhi ho.

Qoum-e-Hud ke Mutalabat:
Qoum-e-Hud ne apne Nabi A.S ki naseehat sun kar jawab diya ke aap jis cheez ki taraf hamein bula rahe hain uski koi daleel-o-hujjat to hamare paas aap laye nahi. Aur yeh hum karne se rahe ke aap kahen apne ma'boodon ko chhor do aur hum chhor hi dein. Na woh aap ko saccha manne wale hain na aap par imaan lane wale hain. Balkir hamara khayal to yeh hai ke chunke tu hamein hamare in ma'boodon ki ibaadat se rok raha hai aur unhein aib lagata hai, is liye jhanjhhala kar un mein se kisi ki maar tujh par parhi hai, teri aql chal gayi hai. 

Yeh sun kar Allah ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: Agar yahi hai to suno, main na sirf tumhe hi balkir Allah ko bhi gawah kar ke aelaan karta hoon ke main Allah ke siva jis jis ki ibaadat ho rahi hai sab se bari aur bezaar hoon. Ab tum hi nahi balkir apne sath auron ko bhi bula lo aur apne in sab jhoote ma'boodon ko bhi mila lo aur tum se jo ho sake mujhe nuqsaan pohncha do. Mujhe koi mohlat na lene do, na mujh par koi tars khao. Jo nuqsaan tumhare bas mein ho mujhe pohnchane mein kami na karo. Mera tawakkul Zaat-e-Rab par hai, woh mera aur tumhara sab ka Malik hai. Na-mumkin hai ke uski mansha ke baghair mera bigaar koi bhi kar sake. 

Duniya bhar ke jandaar uske qabze mein aur uski milkiyat mein hain. Koi nahi jo uske hukm se baahar uski baadshahi se alag ho. Woh zaalim nahi jo tumhare mansobe poore hone de, woh sahi raaste par hai. Bandon ki chotiyan uske haath mein hain, Momin par woh usse bhi zyada meharbaan hai jo meharbaani maa-baap ko aulaad par hoti hai. Woh Kareem hai, uske karm ki koi had nahi. Isi wajah se baaz log behak jaate hain aur ghaafil ho jaate hain. 

Hazrat Hud A.S ke is farmaan par dobara ghaur kijiye ke aap ne Aadiyon ke liye apne is qoul mein Tauheed-e-Rabbani ki bahut se daleelein bayaan kar dein. Bata diya ke jab Allah ke siva koi nafa nuqsaan nahi pohncha sakta, jab uske siva kisi cheez par kisi ka qabza nahi, to phir wahi ek mustahiq-e-ibaadat tehra. Aur jin ki ibaadat tum uske siva kar rahe ho woh sab baatil tehre. Allah un se paak hai, mulk, tasarruf, qabza, ikhtiyar isi ka hai, sab usi ki mahtati mein hain. Uske siva koi ma'bood nahi.

Hud Alaihis Salam ka Qaum ko Jawab

Hazrat Hud Alaihis Salam farmate hain ke apna kaam toh main poora kar chuka, Allah ki risalat tumhein pucha chuka, ab agar tum munh mor lo aur na maano toh tumhara wabaal tum par hi hai na ke mujh par. Allah ko qudrat hai ke woh tumhari jagah unhein de jo us ki tawheed ko maane aur sirf usi ki ibadat karein. Use tumhari koi parwah nahi, tumhara kufr use koi nuqsan nahi dene ka balkay is ka wabaal tum par hi hai. Mera Rab bando par shahid hai. Un ke aqwal-o-afaal us ki nigah mein hain. 

Aakhir un par Allah Ta'ala ka azaab aa gaya. Khair-o-barkat se khali, azaab-o-saza se bhari hui aandhiyan chalne lageen. Us waqt Hazrat Hud Alaihis Salam aur aap ki jama'at-e-muslimeen Allah ke fazl-o-karam aur us ke lutf-o-rahm se nijat pa gaye. Sazaon se bach gaye, sakht azaab un par se hata liye gaye. 

Yeh the Aadi jinhon ne Allah ke sath kufr kiya, Allah ke paighambaron ki maan kar na di. Yeh yaad rahe ke ek nabi ka na-farman kul nabiyon ka na-farman hai. Yeh unhi ki maante rahe jo un mein ziddi aur sarkash the. Allah ki aur us ke momin bando ki la'nat un par baras padi. Is duniya mein bhi un ka zikr la'nat se hone laga aur Qiyamat ke din bhi maidan-e-mahshar mein sab ke samne un par Allah ki la'nat hogi. Aur pukar diya jayega ke Aadi Allah ke munkar hain. 

Hazrat Suddi ka qaul hai ke un ke baad jitne nabi aaye sab un par la'nat hi karte aaye un ki zubani Allah ki la'natein bhi un par hoti rahin.

Hazrat Suddi ka qaul hai ke un ke baad jitne nabi aaye sab un par la'nat hi karte aaye un ki zubani Allah ki la'natein bhi un par hoti rahin.

Hazrat Salih Alaihis Salam Samudiyon ki taraf Allah ke Rasul bana kar bheje gaye thay. Qaum ko Aap ne Allah ki ibadat karne ki aur us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat se baaz aane ki nasihat ki. Batlaya ke insan ki ibtedai paidaish Allah Ta'ala ne mitti se shuru ki hai. Tum sab ke baap dada Adam Alaihis Salam usi mitti se paida hue thay. Isi ne apne fazal se tumhein zameen par basaya hai ke tum is mein guzzaran kar rahe ho. Tumhein Allah se istighfar karna chahiye. Us ki taraf jhuke rehna chahiye. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki Basharat-e-Aulad aur Farishton se Guftugu

Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke paas woh farishte ba-taur-e-mehman ba-shakl-e-insan aate hain jo Qaum-e-Lut ki halakat ki khushkhabri aur Hazrat Ibrahim ke haan farzand hone ki basharat lekar Allah ki taraf se aaye hain. Woh aakar salam karte hain. Aap unke jawab mein salam kehte hain. Is lafz ko pesh se kehne mein ilm-e-bayan ke mutabiq subut-o-dawam paya jata hai. Salam ke baad hi Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam unke samne mehmandari pesh karte hain. Bachray ka gosht jise garm pattharon par senk liya gaya tha, late hain. Jab dekha ke un nau-warid mehmanon ke haath khane ki taraf barhte hi nahi, us waqt unse kuch bad-guman se ho gaye aur kuch dil mein khauf khane lage.

Hazrat Sudi farmate hain ke halakat-e-qaum-e-lut ke liye jo farishte bheje gaye woh ba-surat-e-nau-jawan insan zameen par aaye. Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke ghar par utre, aap ne unhe dekh kar bari takrim ki, jaldi jaldi apna bachra lekar usko garm pattharon par senk kar la hazir kiya aur khud bhi unke sath dastarkhwan par baith gaye. Aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Sarah khilane pilane ke kaam-kaaj mein lag gayin. Zahir hai ke farishte khana nahi khate. Woh khane se ruke aur kehne lage, "Ibrahim! Hum jab talak kisi khane ki qimat na de dein, khaya nahi karte." Aap ne farmaya, "Haan, qimat de dijiye." Unhone pucha, "Kya qimat hai?" Aap ne farmaya, "Bismillah parh kar khana shuru karna aur khana kha kar Alhamdulillah kehna, yahi is ki qimat hai."

Us waqt Hazrat Jibrail ne Hazrat Mikail ki taraf dekha aur dil mein kaha ke fi-l-waqi yeh is qabil hain ke Allah Ta'ala unhe apna Khalil banaye. Ab bhi jo unhone khana shuru na kiya toh aap ke dil mein tarah tarah ke khayalat guzrne lage. Hazrat Sarah ne dekha ke khud Hazrat Ibrahim unke ikram mein yaani unke khane ki khidmat mein hain, taham woh khana nahi khate toh un mehmanon ki ajeeb halat par unhe be-sakhta hansi aa gayi. Hazrat Ibrahim ko khauf-zada dekh kar farishton ne kaha, "Aap khauf na kijiye." Ab dehshat dur karne ke liye asli waqia khol diya ke hum koi insan nahi farishte hain, Qaum-e-Lut ki taraf bheje gaye hain ke unhe halak karein.

Hazrat Sarah ko Qaum-e-Lut ki halakat ki khabar ne khush kar diya. Usi waqt unhe ek dusri khushkhabri bhi mili ke is na-umidi ki umar mein tumhare haan bacha hoga. Unhe ajab tha ke jis qaum par Allah ka azaab utr raha hai, woh puri ghaflat mein hai. Al-garz farishton ne aap ko Ishaq nami bacha paida hone ki basharat di aur phir Ishaq ke haan Yaqub ke hone ki bhi sath hi khushkhabri sunai.

Is ayat se is baat par istadlal kiya gaya hai ke Zabihiullah Hazrat Ismail Alaihis Salam the, kyunke Hazrat Ishaq Alaihis Salam ki toh basharat di hi gayi thi aur sath hi unke haan bhi aulad hone ki basharat di gayi thi. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Sarah Alaihis Salam ne aurton ki aam aadat ke mutabiq is par tajub zahir kiya ke miyan biwi dono ke is barhe hue barhape mein aulad kaisi? Yeh toh sakht hairat ki baat hai. Farishton ne kaha, "Amr-e-Ilahi mein kya hairat?"

Tum dono ko is umr mein hi Allah beta dega go tum se aaj tak koi aulaad nahi hui aur tumhaare miyaan ki umr bhi dhal chuki hai. Lekin Allah ki qudrat mein kami nahi woh jo chahe ho kar rehta hai, اے نبی کے گھر والو (Ae Nabi ke ghar walon) tum par Allah ki rahmaten aur us ki barkaten hain, tumhe is ki qudrat mein taajjub na karna chaahye. Allah Ta'ala tareefon wala aur buzurg hai.
