Ab dehshat dur karne ke liye asli waqia khol diya ke hum koi insan nahi farishte hain, Qaum-e-Lut ki taraf bheje gaye hain ke unhe halak karein.

Hazrat Sarah ko Qaum-e-Lut ki halakat ki khabar ne khush kar diya. Usi waqt unhe ek dusri khushkhabri bhi mili ke is na-umidi ki umar mein tumhare haan bacha hoga. Unhe ajab tha ke jis qaum par Allah ka azaab utr raha hai, woh puri ghaflat mein hai. Al-garz farishton ne aap ko Ishaq nami bacha paida hone ki basharat di aur phir Ishaq ke haan Yaqub ke hone ki bhi sath hi khushkhabri sunai.

Is ayat se is baat par istadlal kiya gaya hai ke Zabihiullah Hazrat Ismail Alaihis Salam the, kyunke Hazrat Ishaq Alaihis Salam ki toh basharat di hi gayi thi aur sath hi unke haan bhi aulad hone ki basharat di gayi thi. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Sarah Alaihis Salam ne aurton ki aam aadat ke mutabiq is par tajub zahir kiya ke miyan biwi dono ke is barhe hue barhape mein aulad kaisi? Yeh toh sakht hairat ki baat hai. Farishton ne kaha, "Amr-e-Ilahi mein kya hairat?"

Tum dono ko is umr mein hi Allah beta dega go tum se aaj tak koi aulaad nahi hui aur tumhaare miyaan ki umr bhi dhal chuki hai. Lekin Allah ki qudrat mein kami nahi woh jo chahe ho kar rehta hai, اے نبی کے گھر والو (Ae Nabi ke ghar walon) tum par Allah ki rahmaten aur us ki barkaten hain, tumhe is ki qudrat mein taajjub na karna chaahye. Allah Ta'ala tareefon wala aur buzurg hai.

Hazrat Ibrahim ki burdbari aur sifarish. Mehmanon ke khana na khane ki wajah se Hazrat Ibrahim ke dil mein jo dehshat samai thi, un ka hal khul jaane par woh door ho gayi. Phir Aap ne apne haan larka hone ki khushkhabri bhi sun li. Aur yeh bhi maloom ho gaya ke yeh farishte Qaum-e-Lut ki halakat ke liye bheje gaye hain, toh Aap farmane lage ke agar kisi basti mein teen sau momin hon, kya phir bhi woh basti halak ki jayegi? Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) aur un ke sathiyon ne jawab diya ke nahi. Phir poochha ke agar chalis hon? Jawab mila phir bhi nahi. Daryaft kiya agar tees hon? Kaha gaya phir bhi nahi. Yahan tak ke tadad ghatate ghatate panch ki babat poochha toh farishton ne yahi jawab diya. Phir ek hi ki nisbat sawal kiya aur yahi jawab mila toh Aap ne farmaya phir is basti ko Hazrat Lut (Alaihis Salam) ki maujudgi mein tum kaise halak karoge? Farishton ne kaha hamen wahan Hazrat Lut ki maujudgi ka ilm hai, use aur us ke ahl-e-khana ko siwaye us ki biwi ke hum bacha lenge. Ab Aap ko itminan ho gaya aur khamosh ho gaye. Hazrat Ibrahim burdbar, narm dil aur ruju rehne wale the, is ayat ki tafsir pehle guzar chuki hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apne paighambar ki behtareen sifaten bayan farmai hain. Hazrat Ibrahim ki is guftagu aur sifarish ke jawab mein farman-e-bari hua ke ab Aap is se chashm-poshi kijiye. Qaza-e-Haq naafiz-o-jari ho gayi, ab azab aayega aur woh lataya na jayega.

Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ke ghar farishton ka nuzul. Hazrat Ibrahim ko yeh farishte apna bhed bata kar wahan se chal diye aur Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ke paas un ke zameen mein ya un ke makan mein pohnche. Mard khoobsurat larkon ki shakal mein the taake Qaum-e-Lut ki poori aazmaish ho jaye, Hazrat Lut un mehmanon ko dekh kar qaum ki halat samne rakh kar sat pata gaye, dil hi dil mein pech taab khane lage ke agar inhein mehman banata hoon toh mumkin hai khabar paakar log charh daudhein aur agar mehman nahi rakhta toh yeh unhi ke hath parh jayenge. Zuban se bhi nikal gaya ke aaj ka din bara haibatnaak din hai. Qaum wale apni shararat se baaz nahi aayenge. Mujh mein un ke muqabla ki taqat nahi. Kya hoga? Qatada farmate hain. Hazrat Lut apni zameen par the ke yeh farishte basoorat-e-insan aaye aur un ke mehman bane. Sharma sharmi inkar toh na sake aur inhein le kar ghar chale, raste mein sirf is niyat se ke yeh ab bhi wapas chale jayenge un se kaha ke Wallah yahan ke logon se zyada bure aur khabees log aur kahin nahi hain. Kuch door ja kar phir yahi kaha gharz ghar pohnchne tak chaar baar yahi kaha. Farishton ko Allah ka hukum bhi yahi tha ke jab tak un ka Nabi, un ki burai na bayan kare inhein halak na karna. Sadi farmate hain ke Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke paas se chal kar dopahar ko yeh farishte nahar-e-Sadoom pohnche wahan Hazrat Lut ki sahabzadi jo pani lene gayi thin, mil gayi'n. Un se unhone poocha ke yahan hum kahin thehar sakte hain. Us ne kaha aap yahin rukiye main wapas aa kar jawab doongi. Inhein dar laga ke agar qaum walon ke hath yeh lag gaye toh un ki bari be-izzati hogi. Yahan aa kar walid sahib se zikr kiya ke shehar ke darwaze par chand pardesi nau-umar log hain, main ne to aaj tak nahi dekhe, jao aur inhein thehrao warna qaum wale inhein satayenge. Is basti ke logon ne Hazrat Lut se keh rakha tha ke dekho kisi bahar wale ko tum apne han thehraya na karo. Hum aap sab kuch kar liya karenge. Aap ne jab yeh halat suni toh ja kar chupke se inhein apne ghar le aaye. Kisi ko kanon kaan khabar na hone di. Magar aap ki biwi jo qaum se mili hui thi, usi ke zariye baat phoot nikli. Ab kya tha. Daure bhage aa gaye, jise dekho khushiyan manata jaldi jaldi lapakta chala aata hai un ki to yeh kho-khaslat ho gayi thi is siyah-kari ko to goya unhone aadat bana liya tha. Us waqt Allah ke Nabi ﷺ inhein naseehat karne lage ke tum is bad-khaslat ko choro apni khwahishein aurton se poori karo. Banat yaani meri larkiyan. Is liye farmaya ke har Nabi apni ummat ka goya baap hota hai. Quran Kareem ki ek aur ayat mein hai ke us waqt unhone kaha tha ke hum to pehle hi aap ko mana kar chuke the ke kisi ko apne han na thehraya karo. Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ne unhein samjhaya aur duniya akhirat ki bhalai unhein sujhai aur kaha ke auratein hi is baat ke liye mozoon hain. Un se nikah kar ke apni khwahish poori karna hi pak kaam hai.

Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain yeh samjha jaye ke Aap ne apni larkiyon ki nisbat yeh farmaya tha nahin balki Nabi apni poori ummat ka goya baap hota hai. Qatadah waghera se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain yeh bhi na samajhna chahiye ke Hazrat Lut ne aurton se benikah milap karne ko farmaya ho. Nahin matlab Aap ka un se nikah kar lene ke hukm ka tha. Farmate hain Allah se daro mera kaha mano, aurton ki taraf raghbat karo, un se nikah kar ke haajat rawai karo. Mardon ki taraf is raghbat se na aao aur khususan yeh to mere mehman hain, meri izrat ka khayal karo kya tum mein ek bhi samajhdar, naik rah-yafta bhala aadmi nahin. Us ke jawab mein un sarkashon ne kaha ke hamein aurton se koi sarokar hi nahin yahan bhi banataka yani teri larkiyan ke lafz se murad qaum ki auratein hain. Aur tujhe maloom hai ke hamara irada kya hai yani hamara irada un larkon se milne ka hai. Phir jhagda aur nasihat besud hai.

Lut Alaihis Salam ki qaum par azab nazil hota hai. Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ne jab dekha ke meri nasihat un par asar nahi karti to unhein dhamkaya ke agar mujh mein quwat, taqat hoti ya mera kunba, qabila zor-dar hota to main tumhe tumhari is shararat ka maza chakha deta. Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek hadith mein farmaya hai ke Allah ki rahmat ho Lut Alaihis Salam par ke woh zor-awar qaum ki panah lena chahte thay. Murad is se zat Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal hai. Aap ke baad phir jo paighambar bheja gaya woh apne abai watan mein hi bheja gaya. Unke is afsurdagi, kamil malal aur sakht tang-dili ke waqt farishton ne aap ko zahir kardaya ke hum Allah ke bheje hue hain yeh log hum tak ya aap tak pahunch hi nahi sakte. Aap raat ke akhri hisse mein apne ahl-o-iyal ko lekar yahan se nikal jayiye khud in sab ke peeche rahiye. Aur seedhe apni rah chale jayiye qaum walon ki ah-o-baka par unke cheekhne chillane par tumhe mud kar bhi na dekhna chahiye. Phir is isbat se Hazrat Lut ki biwi ka istisna karliya ke woh is hukm ki pabandi na kar sakegi. Woh azab ke waqt qaum ki haye-vaye sun kar mud kar dekhegi. Isliye ke Rahmani qaza mein uska bhi unke sath halak hona teh ho chuka hai. Ek qiraat mein illa imraataha tak ta ke pesh se bhi hai jin logon ke nazik pesh aur zabr dono jayiz hain. Unka bayan hai ke aap ki biwi bhi yahan se nikalne mein aap ke sath thi lekin azab ke nazil hone par qaum ka shor sun kar sabr na kar saki aur mud kar unki taraf dekha aur zaban se nikal gaya ke haye meri qaum. Usi waqt aasman se ek patthar us par bhi aya aur woh dhair hogayi. Hazrat Lut ki mazid tashfi ke liye farishton ne is khabis qaum ki halakat ka waqt bhi bayan kardiya ke yeh subh hote hi tabah hojayegi. Aur subh ab bilkul qareeb hai. Yeh kor-batin aap ka ghar ghere hue thay aur har taraf se lapakte hue aapahunche thay. Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam darwaze par khade hue in lotiyon ko rok rahe thay, jab kisi tarah woh na mane aur jab Lut Alaihis Salam azruda-khatir ho kar tang aagaye us waqt Jibril Alaihis Salam ghar mein se nikle aur unke munh par apna par mara jisse unki ankhein andhi hogayin. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman R.A ka bayan hai ke khud Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam bhi in logon ke paas aate, unhein samjhate ke dekho Allah ka azab na kharido magar unhein ne Khalil-ur-Rahman Alaihis Salam ki bhi na mani. Yahan tak ke azab ke aane ka qudrati waqt aapahuncha. Farishte Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ke paas aaye. Aap us waqt apne khet mein kaam kar rahe thay unhon ne kaha ke aaj ki raat hum aap ke mehman hain. Hazrat Jibril ko farman-e-Rabb ho chuka tha ke jab tak Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam teen martaba in ki bad-chalni ki shahadat na de lein. In par azab na kiya jaye. Aap jab unhein lekar chale to chalne ki khabar di ke yahan ke log bade bad hain yeh burai in mein ghusi hui hai. Kuch door aur jaane ke baad dobara kaha ke kya tumhe is basti ke logon ki burai ki khabar nahi? Mere ilm mein to ruye zamin par unse zyada bure log nahi, ah main tumhe kahan le jaun? Meri qaum to tamam makhlooq se badtar hai.

Us waqt Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne farishton se kaha dekho do martaba yeh keh chuke. Jab unhein lekar Aap apne ghar ke darwaze par pohnche toh ranj o afsos se ro diye aur kehne lage meri kaum tamam makhlooq se badtar hai. Tumhein kya maloom nahi ke yeh kis badi mein mubtala hain? Roo-e-zameen par koi basti is basti se buri nahi. Us waqt Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne phir farishton se farmaya dekho teen martaba yeh apni kaum ki badchalni ki shahadat de chuke hain. Yaad rakhna ab azab sabit ho chuka hai. Ghar mein gaye aur yahan se Aap ki burhiya biwi oonchi jagah par chadh kar kapra hilane lagi jise dekhte hi basti ke badkar daure pade. Poocha kya baat hai us ne kaha Lut ke han mehman aaye hain maine toh un se zyada khoobsoorat aur un se zyada khushboo wale log kabhi dekhe hi nahi. Ab kya tha yeh khushi khushi muthiyan band kiye daudte bhagte Hazrat Lut ke ghar ke paas gaye. Charon taraf se Aap ke ghar ko gher liya. Aap ne unhein qasmein dien, pand o nasaehi kiye. Farmaya ke auratein bohat hain. Lekin woh apni shararat aur apne bad irade se baaz na aaye. Us waqt Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se un ke azab ki ijazat chahi Allah ki janib se ijazat mil gayi. Aap apni asli soorat mein zahir ho gaye. Aap ke do par hain. Jin par motiyon ka jadao hai. Aap ke dant safaf chamakte hue hain. Aap ki peshani oonchi aur badi hai. Marjan ki tarah ke dant hain loolo hain aur Aap ke paon sabzi ki tarah hain. Hazrat Lut (A.S) se Aap ne farma diya ke hum toh tere parvardigar ki taraf se bheje hue hain, yeh log tujh tak pohnch nahi sakte. Aap is darwaze se nikal jayiye. Yeh keh kar un ke munh par apna par mara jis se woh andhe ho gaye. Rastoon tak ko nahi pehchan sakte thay. Hazrat Lut (A.S) apne ahl ko lekar raton raat chal diye yeh Allah ka hukum bhi tha. Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Qatadah, Suddi wa gairah ka yahi bayan hai.

Lut Alaihis Salam ki qaum par azab nazil hota hai. Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ne jab dekha ke meri nasihat un par asar nahi karti to unhein dhamkaya ke agar mujh mein quwat, taqat hoti ya mera kunba, qabila zor-dar hota to main tumhe tumhari is shararat ka maza chakha deta. Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek hadith mein farmaya hai ke Allah ki rahmat ho Lut Alaihis Salam par ke woh zor-awar qaum ki panah lena chahte thay. Murad is se zat Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal hai. Aap ke baad phir jo paighambar bheja gaya woh apne abai watan mein hi bheja gaya. Unke is afsurdagi, kamil malal aur sakht tang-dili ke waqt farishton ne aap ko zahir kardaya ke hum Allah ke bheje hue hain yeh log hum tak ya aap tak pahunch hi nahi sakte. Aap raat ke akhri hisse mein apne ahl-o-iyal ko lekar yahan se nikal jayiye khud in sab ke peeche rahiye. Aur seedhe apni rah chale jayiye qaum walon ki ah-o-baka par unke cheekhne chillane par tumhe mud kar bhi na dekhna chahiye. Phir is isbat se Hazrat Lut ki biwi ka istisna karliya ke woh is hukm ki pabandi na kar sakegi. Woh azab ke waqt qaum ki haye-vaye sun kar mud kar dekhegi. Isliye ke Rahmani qaza mein uska bhi unke sath halak hona teh ho chuka hai. Ek qiraat mein illa imraataha tak ta ke pesh se bhi hai jin logon ke nazik pesh aur zabr dono jayiz hain. Unka bayan hai ke aap ki biwi bhi yahan se nikalne mein aap ke sath thi lekin azab ke nazil hone par qaum ka shor sun kar sabr na kar saki aur mud kar unki taraf dekha aur zaban se nikal gaya ke haye meri qaum. Usi waqt aasman se ek patthar us par bhi aya aur woh dhair hogayi. Hazrat Lut ki mazid tashfi ke liye farishton ne is khabis qaum ki halakat ka waqt bhi bayan kardiya ke yeh subh hote hi tabah hojayegi. Aur subh ab bilkul qareeb hai. Yeh kor-batin aap ka ghar ghere hue thay aur har taraf se lapakte hue aapahunche thay. Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam darwaze par khade hue in lotiyon ko rok rahe thay, jab kisi tarah woh na mane aur jab Lut Alaihis Salam azruda-khatir ho kar tang aagaye us waqt Jibril Alaihis Salam ghar mein se nikle aur unke munh par apna par mara jisse unki ankhein andhi hogayin. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman R.A ka bayan hai ke khud Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam bhi in logon ke paas aate, unhein samjhate ke dekho Allah ka azab na kharido magar unhein ne Khalil-ur-Rahman Alaihis Salam ki bhi na mani. Yahan tak ke azab ke aane ka qudrati waqt aapahuncha. Farishte Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ke paas aaye. Aap us waqt apne khet mein kaam kar rahe thay unhon ne kaha ke aaj ki raat hum aap ke mehman hain. Hazrat Jibril ko farman-e-Rabb ho chuka tha ke jab tak Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam teen martaba in ki bad-chalni ki shahadat na de lein. In par azab na kiya jaye. Aap jab unhein lekar chale to chalne ki khabar di ke yahan ke log bade bad hain yeh burai in mein ghusi hui hai. Kuch door aur jaane ke baad dobara kaha ke kya tumhe is basti ke logon ki burai ki khabar nahi? Mere ilm mein to ruye zamin par unse zyada bure log nahi, ah main tumhe kahan le jaun? Meri qaum to tamam makhlooq se badtar hai.

Aaj ke atom bomb us waqt ke patharon ki barish, sooraj ke nikalne ke waqt Allah ka azaab un par aa gaya. Un ki basti Sadum naami teh-o-bala ho gayi. Azaab ne upar tale se dhank liya. Aasman se pakki mitti ke pathar un par barasne lage, jo sakht, wazni aur bahut bare bare thay. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Sijjij Sijjeel dono ek hi hain. Mandud se murad pe-ba-pe, teh-ba-teh, ek ke baad ek ke hain. In pathron par qudrati taur par un logon ke naam likhe hue thay. Jis ke naam ka pathar tha usi par girta tha. Woh misl tauq ke thay jo surkhai mein doobe hue thay. Yeh un shahron par bhi barase aur yahan ke jo log aur gaon goth mein thay un par bhi wahin gire. In mein se jo jahan tha wahin pathar se halak kiya gaya. Koi khada hua, kisi jagah kisi se baaten kar raha hai wahin pathar aasman se aaya aur usay halak kar gaya. Gharz in mein se ek bhi na bacha. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain Hazrat Jibril A.S ne un sab ko jama kar ke un ke makanat aur maweshiyon samet uncha utha liya yahan tak ke un ke kutton ke bhonkne ki aawazein aasman ke farishton ne sun liin. Aap apne dahne par ke kinare par un ki basti ko uthaye hue thay. Phir unhein zameen par ulat diya. Ek ko doosre se takra diya aur sab ek sath gharat ho gaye, akka dukka jo reh gaye thay un ke bheje aasmani pathron ne phod diye aur mahz benam-o-nishane kar diye gaye. Mazkoor hai ke un ki chaar bastiyan thiin. Har basti mein ek lakh aadmiyon ki aabadi thi. Ek riwayat mein hai teen bastiyan thiin. Bari basti ka naam Sadum tha. Yahan kabhi kabhi Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim A.S bhi aa kar waaz naseehat farma jaya karte thay. Phir farmata hai yeh cheezein kuch un se door na thiin. Sunan ki hadis mein hai kisi agar tum liwat karta hua pao toh upar wale neeche wale dono ko qatal kar do.

Ahl-e-Madyan ki janib Hazrat Shuaib ki amad: Arab ka qabila jo Hijaz-o-Sham ke darmiyan Ma'an ke qareeb rehta tha, un ke shahron ka naam aur khud un ka naam bhi Madyan tha. Un ki janib Allah Ta'ala ke Nabi Hazrat Shuaib (Alaihis Salam / A.S) bheje gaye. Aap un mein sharif-un-nasab aur aala khandan ke thay aur unhi mein se thay. Isi liye "akhahum" ke lafz se bayan kiya yaani un ke bhai. Aap ne bhi anbiya ki aadat aur sunnat aur Allah ke pehle aur takeedi hukm ke mutabiq apni kaum ko Allah Ta'ala wahdahu la sharika lahu ki ibaadat karne ka hukm diya. Saath hi naap tol ki kami se roka ke kisi ka haq na maro. Aur Allah ka yeh ehsaan yaad dilaya ke us ne tumhein farigh-ul-baal aur asooda haal kar rakha hai. Aur apna darr zahir kiya ke apni mushrikanana rosh aur zalimana harkat se agar baaz na aaoge toh tumhari yeh achhi halat bad-hali se badal jayegi.

Naap tol mein insaaf karo. Pehle toh apni kaum ko naap tol ki kami se roka. Ab lain-dein ke dono waqt adl-o-insaaf ke sath poore poore naap tol ka hukum dete hain. Aur zameen mein fasaad aur tabahi kari karne ko mana karte hain. In mein rahzani aur daake maarne ki bad-khaslat bhi thi. Logon ke haq maar kar nafa uthane se Allah ka diya hua nafa bahut behtar hai. Allah ki yeh wasiyat tumhare liye khairiyat liye hue hain. Azaab se jaise halakat hoti hai uske muqable mein rehmat se barkat hoti hai. Theek tol kar poore naap kar halal se jo nafa mile usi mein barkat hoti hai. Khabees-o-tayyib mein kya masawat? Dekho main tumhein har waqt dekh nahi raha. Tumhein buraiyon ka tark aur nekiyon ka fa'al Allah hi ke liye karna chahiye na ke duniya dikhave ke liye.

Purane maabodon se dastbardari se inkar. Hazrat A'mash farmate hain, salat se murad yahan qirat hai. Woh log azrah-e-mazaq kehte hain ke wah! Aap acche rahe ke aap ko aap ki qirat ne hukm diya ke hum baap dadon ki rosh ko chhod kar apne purane maabodon ki ibadat se dastbardar ho jaaein. Yeh aur bhi lutf hai ke hum apne maal ke bhi maalik na rahein ke jis tarah jo chahein is mein tasarruf karein kisi ko naap tol mein kam na dein. Hazrat Hasan farmate hain, wallah waqia yahi hai ke Hazrat Shoaib (Alaihis Salam) ki namaz ka hukm yahi tha ke aap unhein ghairullah ki ibadat aur makhlooq ke huqooq ke gazb se rokein. Souri farmate hain ke un ke is qaul ka matlab ke jo hum chahein, apne maalon mein karein, yeh hai ke zakat kyun dein? Nabi Allah ko un ka haleem o rasheed kehna azrah-e-mazaq o haqarat tha.

Qaum ko tabligh, aap apni qaum se farmate hain ke dekho main apne Rab ki taraf se kisi daleel-o-hujjat aur baseerat par qaim hoon aur usi ki taraf tumhein bula raha hoon. Us ne apni meharbani se mujhe behtareen rozi de rakhi hai. Yaani nabuvat ya rizq-e-halal ya dono, meri rosh tum yeh na paoge ke tumhein to bhali baat ka hukm karun aur khud tum se chhup kar us ke bar-aks karun. Meri murad to apni taqat ke mutabiq islah karni hai. Haan mere irada ki kamyabi Allah ke haath hai. Usi par mera bharosa aur tawakkul hai aur usi ki jaanib ruju, tawajju aur jhukna hai. 

Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai, Hakeem bin Muawiyah apne baap se riwayat karte hain ke us ke bhai Malik ne kaha ke hey Muawiyah, Rasool Allah ﷺ ne mere parosiyon ko giraftar kar rakha hai, tum Aap ﷺ ke pas jao. Aap ﷺ se tumhari baat-cheet bhi ho chuki hai aur tumhein Aap ﷺ pehchante bhi hain. Pas main us ke sath chala. Us ne kaha ke mere parosiyon ko Aap ﷺ raha kar dijiye, woh musalman ho chuke thay. Aap ne us se munh pher liya. Woh gazab-naak ho kar uth khada hua aur kehne laga, Wallah agar aap ne aisa jawab diya to log kahenge ke aap humein to parosiyon ke bare mein aur hukm dete hain aur aap khud us ke khilaf karte hain. Is par Aap ne farmaya, kya logon ne aisi baat zubaan se nikali hai? Agar main aisa karun to us ka wabaal mujh par hi hai, un par to nahi. Jao us ke parosiyon ko chhor do. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke us ki qaum ke chand log kisi shubah mein giraftar thay. Is par qaum ka ek admi khas hazir hua. Us waqt Rasool Allah ﷺ khutba farma rahe thay. Us ne kaha ke log kehte hain ke aap kisi cheez se auron ko rokte hain aur khud use karte hain. Aap ne samjha nahi, is liye pucha ke log kya kehte hain? 

Hazrat Bahz bin Hakeem ke dada kehte hain, main ne beech mein bolna shuru kar diya ke acha hai aap ke kan mein yeh naqabil-e-zikr alfaaz na paden, kahin aisa na ho ke aap ke munh se meri qaum ke liye koi bad-dua nikal jaye ke phir unhein falah na mile. Lekin Rasool Allah ﷺ barabar usi koshish mein rahe yahan tak ke Aap ne us ki baat samajh li aur farmane lage, kya unhon ne aisi baat zubaan se nikali hai? Ya un mein se koi is ka qayil hai? Wallah agar main aisa karun to us ka bojh-o-baar mere zimme hai, un par kuch nahi. Us ke parosiyon ko chhor do. 

Usi qabeel se woh hadith bhi hai jise Musnad-e-Ahmad laye hain ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, jab tum meri jaanib se koi aisi hadith suno ke tumhare dil us ka inkar karein aur tumhare badan aur baal us se alag-thalag rahein, yaani mutasir na hon aur tum samajh lo ke woh tum se bahut door hai, to main us se, us se bhi zyada door hoon. Is ki isnad sahih hai. 

Hazrat Masrooq kehte hain ke ek aurat Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood ke paas aayi aur kehne lagi, kya aap baalon mein jor lagane ko mana karte hain? Aap ne farmaya, haan. Us ne kaha, aap ke ghar ki baaz auratein to aisa karti hain. Aap ne farmaya, agar aisa ho to main ne Allah ke naik bande kiwasiyat ki hifazat nahi ki.

Mera irada nahin ke jis cheez se tumhein rokoon uske baraks khud karoon. Hazrat Abu Sulaiman Dabbi kehte hain ke hamare paas Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ke rasale aate the jin mein awamir-o-nawahi likhe hue hote the aur aakhir mein yeh likha hota tha ke main bhi is mein hi hoon jo Allah ke nek bande ne farmaya ke meri taufiq Allah hi ke fazl se hai. Isi par mera tawakkul hai aur isi ki taraf main rujoo karta hoon.

Meri adaawat mein apni barbadi mat mol lo. Farmate hain ke meri adaawat aur bughz mein akar tum apne kufr aur apne gunahon par jam na jao warna tumhe woh azab pahuchega jo tumse pehle aise kamon ka irtikaab karne walon ko pahucha hai. Khusoosan Qaum-e-Lut jo tumse qareeb zamane mein hi guzri hai aur qareeb jagah mein hai, tum apne guzashta gunahon ki maafi mango. Aainda ke liye gunahon se tauba karo. Aisa karne walon par mera Rabb bahut hi meharban hojata hai aur unko apna pyara bana leta hai. Abu Laila Kindi kehte hain ke main apne malik ka janwar thame khara tha. Log Hazrat Usman (R.A) ke ghar ko ghere hue the, aapne upar se sar buland kiya aur yehi ayat tilawat farmai. Aur farmaya meri qaum ke logo mujhe qatal na karo. Tum isi tarah the. Phir aapne apne dono haathon ki ungliyan ek dusri mein daal kar dikhayein.

Qaum-e-Madyan ka jawab aur Allah ka azaab. Qaum-e-Madyan ne kaha ke, "Aye Shu'aib! Aap ki aksar baatein hamari samajh mein toh aati nahin, aur khud aap bhi hum mein be-inteha kamzor hain." Saeed waghera ka qaul hai ke aap ki nigaah kamzor thi, magar aap bahut hi saaf go the, yahan tak ke aap ko Khatib-ul-Anbiya ka laqab haasil tha. Suddi kehte hain is wajah se kamzor kaha gaya hai ke aap akele the, muraad is se aap ki haqarat thi, is liye ke aap ke kunbe wale bhi aap ke deen par na the. Kehte hain ke agar teri baradari ka lihaaz na hota toh hum toh patthar maar maar kar tera qissa hi khatam kar dete, ya yeh ke tujhe dil khol kar bura kehte. Hum mein teri koi qadr-o-manzilat, rifat-o-izzat nahin. Yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya, "Bhaiyo! Tum mujhe meri qarabat-dari ki wajah se chhodte ho, Allah ki wajah se nahin chhodte? Toh kya tumhare nazdeek qabele wale Allah se bhi badh kar hain? Allah ke nabi ko burai pahunchate hue Allah ka khauf nahin karte? Afsos! Tum ne Kitabullah ko peeth peeche daal diya, is ki koi azmat-o-ita'at tum mein na rahi. Khair, Allah Ta'ala tumhare tamam hal-ahwal jaanta hai, woh tumhein poora badla dega."

Saeed waghera ka qaul hai ke aap ki nigaah kamzor thi, magar aap bahut hi saaf go the, yahan tak ke aap ko Khatib-ul-Anbiya ka laqab haasil tha. Suddi kehte hain is wajah se kamzor kaha gaya hai ke aap akele the, muraad is se aap ki haqarat thi, is liye ke aap ke kunbe wale bhi aap ke deen par na the. Kehte hain ke agar teri baradari ka lihaaz na hota toh hum toh patthar maar maar kar tera qissa hi khatam kar dete, ya yeh ke tujhe dil khol kar bura kehte. Hum mein teri koi qadr-o-manzilat, rifat-o-izzat nahin. Yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya, "Bhaiyo! Tum mujhe meri qarabat-dari ki wajah se chhodte ho, Allah ki wajah se nahin chhodte? Toh kya tumhare nazdeek qabele wale Allah se bhi badh kar hain? Allah ke nabi ko burai pahunchate hue Allah ka khauf nahin karte? Afsos! Tum ne Kitabullah ko peeth peeche daal diya, is ki koi azmat-o-ita'at tum mein na rahi. Khair, Allah Ta'ala tumhare tamam hal-ahwal jaanta hai, woh tumhein poora badla dega."

Tumhein anqareeb maloom hojayega ke ruswa karne wale azab kin par nazil hote hain aur Allah ke nazdeek jhoota kaun hai? Tum muntazir raho, main bhi intezar mein hoon." Akhirash un par bhi Azab-e-Ilahi utra, us waqt Nabi-ullah aur momin bacha diye gaye, un par Rahmat-e-Rab hui aur zalimon ko tehsunehs kardiya gaya. Woh jal bhuj, behis-o-harakat reh gaye, aise ke goya kabhi apne gharon mein abad hi na thay. Aur jaise ke un se pehle ke Samudi thay, Allah ki laanat ka bais bane, waise hi yeh bhi hogaye. Samudi un ke parosi thay aur gunah aur badamni mein unhin jaise thay aur yeh dono qaumein Arab hi se talluq rakhti thin.

Qibti qaum ka sardar Firaun aur Musa (Alaihis Salam) - Firaun aur uski jamaat ki taraf Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasul Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko apni aayton aur zahir baahir daleelon ke sath bheja lekin unhon ne Firaun ki itaat na chodi. Usi ki gumrah rawash par us ke peechhe lage rahe. Jis tarah yahan unhon ne uski farman-bardari tark na ki aur use apna sardar mante rahe. Isi tarah Qiyamat ke din usi ke peechhe yeh honge aur woh apni peshwai mein unhe sab ko apne sath hi jahannam mein le jayega aur khud dugna azab bardasht karega. Yahi hal buron ki tabadari karne walon ka hota hai, woh kahenge bhi ke Allah inhin logon ne hamein behkaya to unhe dugna azab de. Musnad mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke Qiyamat ke din jahiliyat ke shairon ka jhanda Amru-ul-Qais ke hath mein hoga aur woh unhe lekar jahannam ki taraf jayega. Us aag ke azab par yeh aur ziyadti hai ke yahan aur wahan donon jagah yeh log abadi lanat mein pade. Qiyamat ke din ki lanat mil kar un par do do lanatein pad gayin. Yeh aur logon ko jahannam ki dawat dene wale imam the. Is liye un par dohari lanat padi.

Ibrat-kade kuch abad hain kuch veeran. Nabiyon aur un ki ummaton ke waqeat bayan farma kar irshad-e-bari hota hai ki yeh un bastiyon walon ke waqeat hain, jinhein hum tere samne bayan farma rahe hain. Un mein se ba'z bastiyan toh ab tak abad hain aur ba'z mit chuki hain. Hum ne unhein zulm se halak nahi kiya, balki khud unhon ne hi apne kufr-o-takzeeb ki wajah se apne upar apne hathon halakat musallat kar li. Aur jin ma'budan-e-batil ke unhein sahare the, woh bar-waqt unhein kuch kaam na aa sake. Balki un ki puja-paat ne unhein aur gharat kar diya. Dono jahan ka wabaal un par aa pada.

Jis tarah in zalimon ki halakat hui un jaisa jo bhi hoga usi natije ko woh bhi dekhega. Allah Ta'ala ki pakar al-manak aur bahut sakhti wali hoti hai. Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala zalimon ko dheel de kar phir pakrenge. Waqt na-gahan daba leta hai. Phir mohlat nahi milti phir Aap ﷺ ne is ayat ki tilawat ki.

Halakat aur Nijaat, Thos Dalail

Kafiron ki us halakat aur mominon ki nijaat mein saaf daleel hai hamare un wadon ki sachai par jo hum ne qayamat ke bare mein kiye hain, jis din tamam awal-o-akhir ke log jama kiye jayenge. Aik bhi baqi na chhootega aur woh bara bhari din hoga, tamam farishtey, tamam rasool, tamam makhlooq hazir hogi. Hakim-e-Haqiqi Adil kafi insaf karega.

Qayamat ke qaim hone mein dair ki wajah yeh hai ke Rab yeh baat pehle hi muqarrar kar chuka hai ke itni muddat tak duniya Bani Adam se abad rahegi. Itni muddat khamoshi par guzregi phir falan waqt qayamat qaim hogi. Jis din qayamat aajayegi, koi na hoga jo Allah ki ijazat ke baghair lab bhi khol sake. Magar Rahman jise ijazat de aur woh baat bhi theek boley.

Tamam awazein Rab-e-Rahman ke samne past hongi. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki Hadis-e-Shafaat mein hai is din sirf rasool hi bolenge aur un ka kalam bhi sirf yehi hoga ke "Ya Allah salamat rakh, ya Allah salamati de."

Majma-e-Mahshar mein bohat se to bure honge aur bohat se naik. Is ayat ke utrne par Hazrat Umar (R.A) poochte hain ke "Phir Ya Rasulallah! Hamare aamal is bina par hain jis se pehle hi faraghat kar li gayi hai ya kisi nayi bina par?" Aap ne farmaya: "Nahin, balki us hisab par jo pehle se khatam ho chuka hai, jo qalam chal chuka hai, lekin har aik ke liye wahi asaan hoga jis ke liye us ki paidayish ki gayi hai."

Azab yafta logon ki cheekhein gadhe ke cheekhne mein jaise zer-o-bam hota hai aise hi un ki cheekhein hongi. Yeh yaad rahe ke Arab ke muhawaron ke mutabiq Quran-e-Kareem nazil hua hai. Woh humeshgi ke muhaware ko isi tarah bola karte hain ke yeh humeshgi wala hai jab tak aasman-o-zamin ko qiyam hai. Yeh bhi un ke muhaware mein hai ke yeh baaqi rahega jab tak din raat ka chakkar bandha hua hai. Pas in alfaaz se humeshgi murad hai na ke qaid. Is ke alawa yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke is zamin-o-aasman ke baad dar-e-akhirat mein un ke siva aur aasman-o-zamin ho pas yahan murad jins hai. Chunacha Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke har jannat ka aasman-o-zamin hai. Is ke baad Allah ki mansha ka zikr hai jaise (An-Naaru maswakum khalidiina fiha illa ma sha-allahu inna rabbaka hakimun 'alim) (Surah Al-An'am: 128) mein hai. Is istisna ke bare mein bahut se qaul hain jinhein Jauzi ne Zad-ul-Masir mein naqal kiya hai. Ibn Jarir ne Khalid bin Ma'dan, Zahhak, Qatada aur Ibn Sinan ke is qaul ko pasand farmaya hai ke muwahid gunehgaron ki taraf istisna aaid hai. Ba'az salaf se is ki tafseer mein bade hi ghareeb aqwal warid hue hain. Qatada farmate hain Allah hi ko is ka poora ilm hai.

Anbiya ke farman-bardar aur jannat rasoolon ke tabi-dar jannat mein rahenge. Jahan se kabhi nikalna na hoga. Zameen-o-asman ki baqa tak un ki bhi jannat mein baqa rahegi magar jo Allah chahe yani yeh baat ba-zatih wajib nahi balki Allah ki mashiyat aur us ke irade par hai. Ba-qaul-e-Zahhak-o-Hasan yeh bhi muwahhid gunahgaron ke haq mein hai, woh kuch muddat jahannam mein guzar kar us ke baad wahan se nikale jayenge. Yeh atiya-e-Rabbani hai jo khatam na hoga, na ghatega. Yeh is liye farmaya ke kahin zikr-e-mashiyat se yeh khatka na guzre ke amadgi (hameshgi) nahi. Jaise ke dozekhiyon ke dawam ke baad bhi apni mashiyat aur irade ki taraf rujoo kiya hai. Sab us ki hikmat-o-adl hai, woh har us kaam ko kar guzarta hai jis ka irada kare. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai: Mot ko chit kabre mendhe ki soorat mein laya jayega aur usay zabih kar diya jayega. Phir farma diya jayega ke ahl-e-jannat tum hamesha rahoge aur mot nahi, aur jahannam walo tumhare liye hameshgi hai mot nahi.

Mushrikin ka Hashr

Mushrikin ke shirk ke baatil hone mein hargiz shubh tak na karna. Unke paas siwaye baap dada ki bhoundi taqlid ke aur daleel hi kya hai? Unki nekiyan unhein duniya mein hi mil jayengi, aakhirat mein azaab hi azaab hoga. Jo khair-o-shukr ke waade hain sab poore hone wale hain. Unka azaab ka muqarrara hissa unhein zaroor pahuchega.

Musa (Alaihis Salam) ko humne Kitab di lekin logon ne tafriqa dala. Kisi ne iqraar kiya to kisi ne inkaar kar diya. Pas unhi nabiyon jaisa haal aap ka bhi hai, koi manega koi talega.

Chunki hum waqt muqarrara kar chuke hain, chunki hum baghair hujjat poori kiye azaab nahi kiya karte isliye yeh taakhir hai warna abhi unhein unke gunahon ka maza yaad aa jata.

Kafiron ko Allah aur uske Rasool ki baatein ghalat hi maloom hoti hain. Unka shaq-o-shubha zail nahi hota. Sab ko Allah jama karega aur unke kiye hue aamal ka badla dega. Is qiraat ka bhi maana is hamare zikr karda maane ki taraf hi lautna hai.

Kafiron ko Allah aur uske Rasool ki baatein ghalat hi maloom hoti hain. Unka shaq-o-shubha zail nahi hota. Sab ko Allah jama karega aur unke kiye hue aamal ka badla dega. Is qiraat ka bhi maana is hamare zikr karda maane ki taraf hi lautna hai.

Istiqaamat ki hidayat, istiqaamat aur seedhi rah par dawaam, humeshgi aur saabit qadmi ki hidayat Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi aur tamaam Musalmanon ko kar raha hai. Yehi sab se bari cheez hai. Saath hi sarkashi se roka hai kyunki yehi tauba karne wali cheez hai go kisi mushrik hi par ki gayi ho. Parvardigar bandon ke har amal se aagah hai, mudahanat aur deen ke kaamon mein susti na karo. Shirk ki taraf na jhuko. Mushrikeen ke amaal par razamandi ka izhar na karo. Zalimon ki taraf na jhuko. Warna aag tumhein pakar legi. Zalimon ki taraf-dari un ke zulm par madad hai, ye hargiz na karo. Agar aisa kiya toh kaun hai jo tumse azaab-e-Allah hataye? Aur kaun hai jo tumhein is se bachaye?

Auqat-e-Namaz ki Nishandahi:
Ibn Abbas R.A waghera kehte hain din ke dono saron se murad subh ki aur maghrib ki namaz hai. Qatadah, Zahhak waghera ka qaul hai ke pehle sary se murad subh ki namaz aur dosre se murad zuhar aur asar ki namaz hai. Raat ki ghadiyon se murad isha ki namaz hai, ba-qaul Mujahid waghera maghrib o isha ki namaz. 

Nekiyon ko karna gunahon ka kaffarah ho jata hai. Sunan mein hai An-Hazrat ﷺ farmate hain: "Jis musalman se koi gunah ho jaye phir woh wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz padh le, to Allah uske gunah maaf farma deta hai." 

Ek martaba Hazrat Usman R.A ne wuzu kiya phir farmaya, "Isi tarah maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko wuzu karte dekha hai aur Aap ﷺ ne farmaya hai: Jo mere is wuzu jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare, jismein apne dil se baatein na kare, to uske tamam agle gunah maaf kar diye jate hain." 

Musnad mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne pani mangwaya, wuzu kiya, phir farmaya, "Mere is wuzu ki tarah Rasool Allah ﷺ wuzu kiya karte thay." Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo mere is wuzu jaisa wuzu kare aur khada ho kar zuhar ki namaz ada kare, uske subh se le kar ab tak ke gunah maaf ho jate hain, phir asar ki namaz padhe, to zuhar se asar tak ke gunah bakhsh diye jate hain, phir maghrib ki namaz ada kare, to asar se le kar maghrib tak ke gunah bakhsh diye jate hain, phir isha ki namaz se maghrib se isha tak ke gunah maaf ho jate hain, phir yeh sota hai, lot-pot hota hai, phir subh uth kar namaz-e-fajr padh lene se isha se le kar subh ki namaz tak ke sab gunah bakhsh diye jate hain." 

Yahi hain woh bhalaiyan jo buraiyon ko door kar deti hain. Sahih hadith mein Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: "Batlao to agar tum mein se kisi ke makan ke darwaze par hi nehar jari ho aur woh us mein har din paanch martaba ghusal karta ho, to kya uske jism par zara si bhi mail baki reh jayegi?" Logon ne kaha: "Hargiz nahi." Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bas yahi misal hai paanch namazon ki ke un ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala khatayein aur gunah maaf farma deta hai." 

Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: "Paanchon namazein aur juma juma tak aur Ramadan Ramadan tak ka kaffarah hain jab tak ke kabira gunahon se parheiz kiya jaye." 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai: "Har namaz apne se pehle ki khataon ko mita deti hai." 

Bukhari mein hai ke kisi shakhs ne ek aurat ka bosa le liya phir Hazrat ﷺ se apne is gunah ki nidamat zahir ki. Is par yeh ayat utri. Usne kaha: "Kya mere liye hi yeh makhsoos hai?" Aap ﷺ ne jawab diya: "Nahi, balki meri sari ummat ke liye yahi hukm hai." 

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke usne kaha: "Maine bagh mein us aurat se sab kuch kiya, haan jama'at (jima') nahi kiya, ab main hazir hoon jo saza mere liye aap tajweez farmayein main bardasht kar lunga." Huzoor ﷺ ne use koi jawab na diya, woh chala gaya. Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya: "Allah ne is ki parda-poshi ki thi, agar yeh bhi apne nafs ki parda-poshi karta." 

An-Hazrat ﷺ barabar usi shakhs ki taraf dekhte rahe phir farmaya: "Use wapas bula lao." Jab woh aa gaya to Aap ﷺ ne usi ayat ki tilawat farmayi.

Us par Hazrat Ma'az ne daryaft kiya ke "Kya yeh usi ke liye hai?" Aap ne farmaya nahin balki sab logon ke liye hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai. Rasoolullah ﷺ farmate hain "Allah Ta'ala ne jis tarah tum mein roziyan taqseem farmai hain, akhlaq bhi taqseem farmaye hain. Allah Ta'ala duniya to use bhi deta hai jis se khush ho aur use bhi jis se ghazabnak ho, lekin deen sirf unhi ko deta hai jin se use mohabbat ho. Pas jise deen mil jaye yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala us se mohabbat rakhta hai. Us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, banda musalman nahin hota jab tak ke uska dil aur uski zaban musalman na hojaye, aur banda imandar nahin hota jab tak ke uske parosi uski aizaon se be-fikr na hojayein." Logon ne pucha aizaen kya kya? Farmaya dhoka aur zulm. Suno, jo shakhs maal-e-haram kamaye phir us mein se kharch kare, Allah use barkat se mehroom rakhta hai. Agar woh us mein se sadqa kare to qubool nahin hota aur jitna kuch apne baad baaki chhor mare, woh sab uske liye aag dozakh ka tosha banta hai. Yaad rakho Allah Ta'ala burai ko burai se nahin mitata balki burai ko bhalai se mitata hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ke pas aaya aur kaha ke ek aurat sauda lene ke liye aati thi, afsos ke main use kothri mein le jaakar us se ba-juz jama'at ke aur har tarah lutf-andoz hua. Ab jo Allah ka hukm ho woh mujh par jari kiya jaye. Aap ne farmaya shayad uska khawand ghair-hazir hoga? Us ne kaha ji haan yeh baat thi. Aap ne farmaya tum jao Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq se yeh masla pucho. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq ne bhi yehi sawal kiya pas aap ne bhi Hazrat Umar ki taraf farmaya, phir woh An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur apni halat bayan ki. Aap ne farmaya shayad uska khawand Allah ki rah mein gaya hua hoga? Pas Quran-e-Kareem ki yeh aayat utri to kehne laga "Kya yeh khas mere liye hi hai?" To Hazrat Umar ne uske seene par haath rakh kar farmaya nahin is tarah sirf teri hi aankhen thandi nahin hosaktin balki yeh sab logon ke liye aam hai. Yeh sun kar Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya Umar sache hain. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke woh aurat mujh se ek dirham ki khajoorein kharindne aayi thi to main ne use kaha ke andar kothri mein is se bahut achhi khajoorein hain, woh andar gayi main ne bhi andar jaakar use chum liya. Phir woh Hazrat Umar R.A ke pas gaya to aap ne farmaya Allah se dar aur apne nafs par parda daale reh. Lekin Abu-al-Yasar R.A kehte hain mujh se sabr na hosaka, main ne jaakar Huzoor ﷺ se waqia bayan kiya. Aap ne farmaya afsos! Tu ne ek ghazi mard ki is ghair-hazri mein aisi khayanat ki. Main ne to yeh sun kar apne aap ko jahannami samajh liya aur mere dil mein khayal aane laga ke kash ke mera islam uske baad ka hota? Huzoor ﷺ ne zara si der apni gardan jhuka li, usi waqt Hazrat Jibrail yeh aayat lekar utre. Ibn Jarir mein hai ke ek shakhs ne aakar Huzoor ﷺ se darkhwast ki Allah ki muqarrar karda had mujh par jari kijiye.

Aik do dafa us ne yeh kaha lekin Aap ne us ki taraf se munh mor liya. Phir jab namaz khari hui aur Aap namaz se farigh huwe toh daryaft farmaya ke woh shakhs kahan hai? Us ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ main hazir hoon. Aap ne farmaya tu ne achhi tarah wuzu kiya? Aur hamare sath namaz parhi, us ne kaha ji han. Aap ne farmaya bas tu toh aisa hi hai jaise apni maan ke pait se paida huwa tha. Khabardar ab koi aisi harkat na karna. Aur Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat utari. Hazrat Abu Usman ka bayan hai ke main Hazrat Salman ke sath tha. Unhon ne aik darakhth ki khushk shakh pakar ke use jhanjhora toh tamam khushk pattay jhar gaye, phir farmaya Abu Usman tum poochte nahi ho ke main ne yeh kyun kiya? Main ne kaha han janab irshad ho. Farmaya isi tarah mere sath Rasool Allah ﷺ ne kiya. Phir farmaya jab banda musalman achhi tarah wuzu kar ke panchon namazen ada karta hai toh us ke gunah aise hi jhar jate hain jaise us khushk shakh ke pattay jhar gaye". Phir Aap ne usi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. Musnad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain burai agar koi hojaye toh us ke peechhe hi neki karlo ke use mita de. Aur logon se khush akhlaqi se mila karo. Aur hadith mein hai "Jab tujh se koi gunah hojaye toh us ke peechhe hi neki karliya kar taake yeh use mita de, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah kya La Ilaha Illallah parhna bhi neki hai? Aap ne farmaya woh toh behtareen aur afzal neki hai". Abu Yala mein hai: "Din raat ke jis waqt mein koi La Ilaha Illallah parhe us ke namah-e-amal mein se buraiyan mit jati hain yahan tak ke un ki jagah waisi hi nekiyan hojati hain". Us ke rawi Usman mein zauf hai. Bazar mein hai aik shakhs ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poochha ke Huzoor ﷺ main ne koi khwahish aisi nahi chhori jise poori na ki ho. Aap ne farmaya kya tu Allah ke aik hone ki aur meri risalat ki gawahi deta hai? Us ne kaha han, toh Aap ne farmaya bas yeh un sab par ghalib rahegi.

Tareeqe mukhtalif, mali halaat judagana ek ek ke matahat yahan murad deen-o-mazahib ka ikhtilaf hai. Jin par Allah ka raham ho jaye woh rasoolon ki tabadari, Rabb Ta'ala ki hukm-bardari mein barabar lage rehte hain. Ab woh Nabi-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman ﷺ ke mutee hain. Aur yehi najat pane wale hain.

Chanacha Musnad-o-Sunan mein hadith hai jis ki har sanad doosri sanad ko taqwiyat pohncha rahi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke yahudiyon ke ikhattar giroh hue, Nasara behtar firqon mein taqseem ho gaye, is ummat ke tehatar firqey ho jayenge, sab jahannumi hain siwai ek jamaat ke, Sahaba R.A ne poocha "Ya Rasool Allah woh kon log hain?" Aap ne jawab diya woh jo us par ho jis par main hoon aur mere ashab (Mustadrak Hakim).

Baqoul-e-Ata mukhtalifeen se murad yahudi, nasrani, majusi hain aur Allah ke raham wali jamaat se murad yak-tarfa deen-e-Islam ke mutee log hain. Qatadah kehte hain ke ye jamaat hai go ke un ke watan aur badan juda hon aur ahl-e-masiyat firqat-o-ikhtilaf wale hain go ke un ke watan aur badan ek hi ja jama hon. Qudrati taur par un ki paidaish hi isisi liye hai, shaqi-o-saeed ki azli taqseem hai. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke rehmat hasil karne wali ye jamaat bilkhusoos isisi liye hai.

Hadrat Tawus ke paas do shakhs apna jhagra lekar aaye aur aapsi ikhtilaf mein bohat barh gaye toh aap ne farmaya ke tum ne jhagra aur ikhtilaf kiya, us par ek shakhs ne kaha isisi liye hum paida kiye gaye hain. Aap ne farmaya, ghalat hai! Us ne apne suboot mein isi ayat ki tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya is liye nahin paida kiya ke aapsi mein ikhtilaf karein, balke paidaish toh jamal ke liye aur rehmat hasil karne ke liye hui hai jaise ke Ibn Abbas R.H se marwi hai ke rehmat ke liye paida kiya hai na ke azab ke liye. Aur ayat mein hai:
(وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْاِنْسَ اِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوْنَ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 56)
"Maine jinno aur insano ko sirf apni ibadat ke liye hi paida kiya hai."

 Teesra qoul hai ke rehmat aur ikhtilaf ke liye paida kiya hai. Chanacha Malik is ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke ek firqa jannati aur ek jahannumi, unhein rehmat hasil karne aur unhein ikhtilaf mein masroof rehne ke liye paida kiya hai. Tere Rabb ka ye faisla natiq hai ke is ki makhlooq mein in dono aqsam ke log honge aur in dono se jannat dozakh par kiye jayenge. Is ki kamil hikmaton ko wohi janta hai.

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke jannat dozakh dono mein aapsi guftagu hui. Jannat ne kaha mujh mein toh sirf zaeef aur kamzor log hi dakhil hote hain aur jahannam ne kaha main takabbur aur zulm karne walon ke sath makhsoos ki gayi hoon. Is par Allah Ta'ala Azzawajjal ne jannat se farmaya tu meri rehmat hai, jise main chahoon use tujh se nawaz doonga.

Aur Jahannam se farmaya tu mera azab hai jis se main chahun tere azab ke zariye us se inteqam lun ga. Tum dono par ho jaoge. Jannat mein to barabar ziyadati rahegi yahan tak ke us ke liye Allah Ta'ala ek nayi makhlooq paida karega aur use us mein basaega aur Jahannam bhi barabar ziyadati talab karti rahegi yahan tak ke us par Allah Rabbul Izzat apna qadam rakh dega tab woh kahegi teri izzat ki qasam ab bas hai bas hai.

Jis par Allah Ta'ala ka karam ho, Allah ki qudr kisi kaam se aajiz nahin. Woh chahe toh sab ko hi Islam ya kufr par jama karde lekin is ki hikmat hai jo insani raaye un ke deen-o-mazahib juda juda barabar jari-o-sari hain. Zikr-e-Maazi tumhare liye saaman-e-sukoon: Pehli ummaton ka apne nabiyon ko jhutlana, nabiyon ka un ki ezaon par sabr karna. Aakhir Allah ke azab ka aana, kafiron ka barbaad hona, nabiyon, rasoolon aur mominon ka najaat pana, yeh sab waqaiat hum tujhe suna rahe hain. Taake tere dil ko hum aur mazboot kardein aur tujhe kamil sukoon hasil ho jaye. Is surat mein bhi haq tujh par wazeh ho chuka hai ke is duniya mein bhi tere samne sachche waqaiat bayan ho chuke hain. Yeh ibrat hai kuffar ke liye aur naseehat hai mominon ke liye ke woh is se nafa hasil karein.

Bator-e-dhamkane, darane aur hoshyar karne ke in kafiryon se keh do ke acha tum apne tareeqe se nahin hatte toh na hato hum bhi apne tareeqe par kar-band hain. Tum muntazir raho ke akhir anjam kya hota hai hum bhi usi anjam ki rah dekhte hain. Fa Alhamdulillah, duniya ne in kafiryon ka anjam dekh liya, in musalmanon ka bhi jo Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se duniya par cha gaye, mukhalifeen par kamyabi ke sath ghalba hasil kar liya, duniya ko mutthi mein le liya, fa lillahil hamd.

Ilm-e-Ghaib aur Hakimiyat-e-Aala sirf Allah hi ko sazawar hai. Asman-o-Zamin ke har ghaib ko janne wala sirf Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal hi hai. Usi ki sab ko ibadat karni chahiye aur usi par bharosa karna chahiye. Jo bhi is par bharosa rakhe woh uske liye kafi hai. Hazrat Ka'b (R.H) farmate hain ke Taurat ka khatima bhi inhi ayaton par hai. Allah Ta'ala makhlooq mein se kisi ke kisi amal se behabar nahi.
